66345.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中有一個大型、邊界清楚的肉芽腫，由類上皮組織球與數個多核巨細胞（multinucleated giant cell）組成，外圍有同心圓狀纖維化與小淋巴球環繞；本視野中央未見明確的無細胞乾酪樣壞死，乾酪化需在其他切面或高倍確認。
features: Large well-circumscribed granuloma composed of confluent epithelioid histiocytes with elongated pale nuclei and pink cytoplasm
Several multinucleated giant cells within the granuloma, with peripherally arranged nuclei (Langhans-like)
Concentric lamellar fibrosis around the granuloma
Dense cuff of small lymphocytes at the periphery
No definite central acellular caseous necrosis in this field; surrounding marrow with fat and hemorrhage
66345.describe_en: Bone marrow trephine biopsy shows a large, well-formed granuloma composed of epithelioid histiocytes and several multinucleated giant cells, surrounded by concentric fibrosis and a dense rim of small lymphocytes. The adjacent marrow shows fat and residual hematopoietic elements. A definite central zone of amorphous acellular caseous necrosis is not evident in this field. Findings are consistent with granulomatous inflammation; caseation should be confirmed on additional levels, and special stains (AFB, GMS) and cultures are recommended to exclude mycobacterial or fungal infection.

ddx.vs: Sarcoid granulomas are tight, non-necrotizing and often multiple and confluent, with infection excluded by stains and culture.
Fungal granulomas can be identical on H&E but show yeasts on GMS/PAS.
Look for a polymorphous background with eosinophils and CD30+/CD15+ Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells between granulomas.
Lipogranulomas are small with fat vacuoles and lack giant cell-rich epithelioid nodules and fibrosis.

65897.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片呈廣泛纖維化（銀染為粗網狀纖維 MF-3），H&E 中在纖維間質裡有成條索、小巢狀的上皮樣細胞，細胞質豐富淡嗜酸性，內插圖可見細胞質內空泡（原始血管腔）；這些細胞 ERG 核染、CD34 膜染、TFE3 核染陽性而 CAMTA1 陰性，指向 TFE3 型上皮樣血管內皮瘤。
features: Reticulin stain: dense coarse reticulin fibers outlining nests and cords, grade MF-3 (A)
H&E: fibrotic marrow with cords and small nests of epithelioid cells embedded in a pale fibromyxoid stroma (B)
High-power inset: epithelioid cells with round-oval nuclei, fine chromatin, distinct nucleoli and abundant pale eosinophilic cytoplasm, including intracytoplasmic vacuoles/lumina (B inset)
ERG strong nuclear positivity in the lesional cells (C)
CD34 membranous/cytoplasmic positivity outlining epithelioid cells (D); TFE3 diffuse nuclear positivity (E)
CAMTA1 negative (F)
65897.describe_en: Bone marrow trephine shows extensive fibrosis with dense coarse reticulin (MF-3). Within the fibrotic stroma there are cords and small nests of epithelioid cells with round to oval nuclei, fine chromatin, distinct nucleoli and abundant pale eosinophilic cytoplasm, some containing intracytoplasmic vacuoles suggestive of primitive vascular lumina. The lesional cells are positive for ERG and CD34 and show diffuse nuclear TFE3, while CAMTA1 is negative. Given confirmed TFE3 rearrangement by FISH, findings are consistent with epithelioid hemangioendothelioma, TFE3-rearranged (YAP1::TFE3 type), involving the marrow in a patient with essential thrombocythemia; this fibrosis should not be attributed solely to post-ET myelofibrosis.

ddx.vs: MPN-related fibrosis contains clustered atypical megakaryocytes and streaming hematopoietic cells, but not ERG/CD34-positive epithelioid cell cords.
Carcinoma nests are cytokeratin-positive and ERG/CD34-negative, whereas these cells are endothelial (ERG+, CD34+); note EHE can express keratin focally.
Angiosarcoma shows marked atypy, brisk mitoses, necrosis and anastomosing vascular channels rather than bland cords with intracytoplasmic lumina.
The conventional EHE subtype is nuclear CAMTA1-positive and TFE3-negative, the opposite of this case.

65897.stain: Reticulin; H&E; IHC: ERG, CD34, TFE3, CAMTA1

65769.recognize_zh: 周邊血嗜中性球同時出現低分葉圓核（假性 Pelger-Huët）、胞質大量空泡與核碎裂（karyorrhexis），骨髓抹片再見到吞噬細胞的巨噬細胞；這種抗有絲分裂藥物毒性組合提示秋水仙素中毒。
features: Neutrophils with hyposegmented, round to bilobed nuclei and condensed chromatin (pseudo-Pelger-Huet change)
Abundant, discrete clear cytoplasmic vacuoles in a bilobed neutrophil
Nuclear karyorrhexis: neutrophil nucleus broken into several separate dense fragments
Marrow precursor with irregular outline, granular cytoplasm and peripheral vacuoles
Large vacuolated macrophage containing engulfed nuclear debris and a partially digested cell (hemophagocytosis)
Red cells unremarkable apart from mild anisocytosis; no organisms seen
65769.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows neutrophils with hyposegmented, pseudo-Pelger-Huet nuclei and coarse chromatin, some with prominent cytoplasmic vacuolation and others with karyorrhectic nuclear fragments. The accompanying bone marrow aspirate shows precursors with similar vacuolated, dysplastic-appearing cytoplasm and a vacuolated macrophage engulfing nuclear material and cells, consistent with hemophagocytosis. No blasts or intracellular organisms are identified. In the appropriate clinical setting, these combined toxic-dysplastic changes are suggestive of an antimitotic drug effect such as colchicine toxicity.

ddx.vs: MDS dysplasia is persistent and clonal without the acute karyorrhexis and heavy vacuolation seen here, and it resolves not with drug withdrawal but requires cytogenetic/molecular confirmation.
Sepsis-related vacuolation is usually accompanied by toxic granulation and Dohle bodies and positive cultures, whereas mitotic-arrest karyorrhexis and pseudo-Pelger forms point to a drug effect.
The inherited anomaly affects nearly all neutrophils uniformly without vacuoles, karyorrhexis or cytopenias.
Hemophagocytosis alone does not explain the neutrophil nuclear fragmentation; toxicology and history distinguish secondary drug-induced HLH-like features.

65385.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片低倍下正常造血組織被取代，骨小樑間可見上皮樣細胞呈巢狀、細胞質淡染或透明，伴隨纖維化、出血與不規則增厚的骨小樑，符合轉移癌侵犯骨髓。
features: Marrow spaces replaced by nests and cords of epithelioid cells with pale to clear cytoplasm
Desmoplastic, edematous stroma with hemorrhage between tumor nests
Irregular, thickened bone trabeculae with prominent cement lines, suggestive of reactive new bone formation
A lobulated cluster of clear/vacuolated cells adjacent to bone (right)
Normal hematopoietic elements not identified in this field; low power limits nuclear detail
65385.describe_en: Low-power H&E section of a bone marrow trephine shows effacement of the marrow space by nests and cords of epithelioid cells with pale to clear cytoplasm, set in an edematous desmoplastic stroma with hemorrhage. Adjacent bone trabeculae are irregular and thickened with prominent cement lines, suggesting reactive (osteoblastic) new bone formation. Residual normal hematopoiesis is not evident in this field, and nuclear detail cannot be assessed at this magnification. Findings are consistent with metastatic carcinoma; in this clinical context immunohistochemistry for cytokeratin, NKX3.1 and PSA would support prostatic origin.

ddx.vs: Mast cell aggregates are paratrabecular spindle or oval cells with eosinophils and fibrosis, and are CD117/tryptase positive and cytokeratin negative.
Histiocytes form loose non-cohesive clusters with foamy cytoplasm and are CD68/CD163 positive, cytokeratin negative.
Shows fibrosis and osteosclerosis with atypical megakaryocytes but no cohesive epithelial nests.
Shows mosaic cement lines and osteoclast activity with fibrovascular marrow but lacks epithelial tumor cells.

65321.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片 CD4 免疫染色中，脂肪空泡之間幾乎所有細胞都呈強烈的膜與細胞質棕色染色，顯示單一形態的 CD4 陽性細胞瀰漫取代骨髓，配合 CD123 等標記支持母細胞性漿細胞樣樹突細胞腫瘤（BPDCN）。
features: Diffuse sheets of medium-sized cells between fat spaces
Strong membranous and cytoplasmic CD4 staining in the vast majority of cells
Monotonous round cell outlines highlighted by the chromogen
Few scattered CD4-negative cells with blue hematoxylin-stained nuclei
Near-complete replacement of normal hematopoiesis
65321.describe_en: CD4 immunohistochemical stain of the bone marrow trephine biopsy shows diffuse infiltration by sheets of monotonous medium-sized cells with strong membranous and cytoplasmic CD4 positivity, largely replacing normal hematopoietic elements between fat spaces. Only occasional CD4-negative cells are identified. CD4 alone is not lineage-specific, and co-expression of CD123, CD56, TCF4 and TCL1 with absence of lineage markers should be confirmed. Findings support marrow involvement by blastic plasmacytoid dendritic cell neoplasm.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with monocytic differentiation
ddx.vs: Monocytic AML also expresses CD4 and CD56 but is lysozyme/CD14/CD11c/MPO-positive and usually lacks strong CD123 with TCF4 and TCL1.
T-cell lymphomas express CD3 and other T-cell antigens, which BPDCN lacks.

ddx.dx: Mature plasmacytoid dendritic cell proliferation associated with CMML
ddx.vs: Reactive or clonal mature pDC nodules are CD34/TdT-negative small aggregates with CD56 negativity, not diffuse blastic sheets.

65257.recognize_zh: 分葉核嗜中性球細胞質中除細小粉紅顆粒外，於右緣與左下方各有小而清楚的藍綠色包涵體，核葉之間也有一個含淡灰物質的空泡；這些藍綠色包涵體即「critical green inclusions」，提示急性肝損傷或乳酸中毒等危重狀態。圖片解析度有限。
features: Segmented neutrophil with an irregularly lobated nucleus and coarse chromatin
Small blue-green cytoplasmic inclusions at the right margin and lower-left cytoplasm
Central cytoplasmic vacuole containing pale grey material between the nuclear lobes
Fine pink cytoplasmic granulation with a few small clear vacuoles
Adjacent large red cells and small platelets; image upscaled with limited resolution
65257.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a mature segmented neutrophil with fine pink granules, scattered small vacuoles, a central vacuole with pale grey material, and small discrete blue-green cytoplasmic inclusions at the cell periphery. Surrounding red cells are enlarged, and small platelets are present. Resolution limits confident assessment of inclusion color and refractility. The findings are consistent with green neutrophil inclusions ('critical green inclusions'), a marker of acute liver injury or lactic acidosis that warrants prompt communication to the clinical team.

ddx.vs: Döhle bodies are ill-defined, pale blue-grey peripheral patches rather than small, sharply outlined blue-green inclusions.
Toxic vacuoles are clear and may contain basophilic organisms but not discrete green refractile bodies.
Bacteria appear as uniform deeply basophilic cocci or rods, often within vacuoles, and are confirmed by Gram stain or culture.

65193.recognize_zh: 骨髓觸片中大部分為大型原紅血球（proerythroblast），核圓、染色質細、細胞質深藍並有泡狀突起，PAS 呈粗塊狀顆粒陽性；切片中母細胞沿血竇（sinusoidal）呈簇狀分布，免疫染色膜狀陽性且 p53 強核染色，符合 TP53 異常的急性紅血球系白血病。
features: Peripheral blood: leukoerythroblastic picture with circulating nucleated red cells and a dysplastic neutrophil
Touch imprint: sheets of large proerythroblasts with round nuclei, fine chromatin, nucleoli and deeply basophilic cytoplasm with blebs, admixed with later erythroid precursors
PAS stain (inset): coarse chunky/globular cytoplasmic positivity in erythroblasts
Biopsy: hypercellular marrow with clusters of blasts within dilated sinusoidal spaces between bone trabeculae
Immunostains: membranous staining of intrasinusoidal blast clusters (erythroid/E-cadherin markers) and strong diffuse nuclear p53
65193.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows rare circulating erythroblasts and granulocytic dysplasia. The bone marrow touch preparation is dominated by erythroid precursors, most of which are proerythroblasts with fine chromatin, nucleoli and deeply basophilic cytoplasm with blebs; PAS highlights coarse globular cytoplasmic positivity. The core biopsy shows a hypercellular marrow with blast clusters in a sinusoidal distribution, which are positive for erythroid markers and E-cadherin with strong nuclear p53 expression. Findings are consistent with acute erythroid leukemia with a sinusoidal growth pattern and TP53 abnormality, arising from post-ET myelofibrosis.

ddx.vs: Megaloblastic erythroid hyperplasia shows orderly maturation to late megaloblasts with nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony and no p53 overexpression or PAS block positivity in proerythroblast sheets.
Megakaryoblasts also have basophilic blebby cytoplasm and a sinusoidal pattern, but are CD61/CD42b positive rather than glycophorin A/E-cadherin positive.

ddx.dx: Pure red cell aplasia recovery / parvovirus
ddx.vs: Parvovirus shows giant pronormoblasts with glassy intranuclear inclusions in a hypocellular erythroid background without p53 overexpression.

ddx.dx: Metastatic small round blue cell tumor
ddx.vs: Metastatic tumors form cohesive nests and express keratin or neuroendocrine markers rather than erythroid markers and CD71.

65193.stain: Wright-Giemsa; PAS; H&E; IHC: glycophorin A, E-cadherin, p53

65129.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片 H&E 下幾乎全為成片細胞，細胞核小而偏心、細胞質淡染並充滿大小不一的透明空泡，低倍看起來像組織球聚集；需搭配 CD138 才能確認為空泡化的漿細胞浸潤。
features: Hypercellular marrow replaced by sheets of cells with abundant pale, finely to coarsely vacuolated cytoplasm
Small round, often eccentric, hyperchromatic nuclei
Numerous clear vacuoles of varying size producing a foamy, histiocyte-like texture
Near-complete effacement of normal trilineage hematopoiesis in this field
Individual cell detail limited at this magnification
65129.describe_en: Bone marrow trephine biopsy (H&E) shows a hypercellular marrow with near-total replacement by sheets of cells containing small round, eccentric nuclei and abundant pale cytoplasm with numerous clear vacuoles, giving a foamy, pseudo-histiocytic appearance. Normal hematopoietic elements are markedly reduced in this field. The morphology alone raises histiocytic or storage disorders, but in this case the cells were CD138-positive plasma cells. Findings are consistent with extensive marrow involvement by a plasma cell neoplasm with vacuolated cytoplasm.

ddx.dx: Gaucher disease or other storage histiocytosis
ddx.vs: Storage cells have larger, fibrillary or crumpled-tissue cytoplasm and are CD68+/CD138-, whereas these cells were CD138-positive.
Signet-ring carcinoma cells have mucin vacuoles indenting the nucleus and are cytokeratin-positive, unlike CD138+ light-chain-restricted plasma cells.

Crystal-storing histiocytes contain eosinophilic crystalline material and are CD68+, often accompanying a small clonal plasma cell population rather than replacing the marrow as sheets of plasma cells.

64745.recognize_zh: 中央一個巨大原紅血球，深藍細胞質邊緣不規則並有偽足樣突起與細小空泡，巨大圓核內為淡紫色毛玻璃樣包涵體並含淡色核仁樣區，染色質推向核緣，周圍嗜中性球與單核細胞相對很小，是 Parvovirus B19 感染的燈籠細胞。
features: Giant pronormoblast with irregular, pseudopod-like cytoplasmic projections (scale bar 10 µm)
Deeply basophilic cytoplasm with fine vacuoles and a paler perinuclear zone
Very large round nucleus with glassy, pale lilac intranuclear inclusion and peripherally marginated chromatin
Pale nucleolus-like bodies within the nucleus
Surrounding band and segmented neutrophils, a myelocyte/monocytoid cell and erythrocytes
64745.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a giant pronormoblast with irregular, deeply basophilic, finely vacuolated cytoplasm and a large nucleus replaced by pale, glassy inclusion material with chromatin condensed along the nuclear membrane. Surrounding granulocytic elements and red cells are unremarkable and provide a size comparison. The findings are consistent with a parvovirus B19-infected giant pronormoblast (lantern cell), supporting parvovirus B19 infection with erythroid maturation arrest.

ddx.vs: PEL has sheets of proerythroblast-like blasts with nucleoli but no glassy viral nuclear inclusions, and usually complex karyotype with TP53 mutation.
Megakaryoblasts share blebby basophilic cytoplasm but have fine chromatin with nucleoli rather than a glassy inclusion and are CD61-positive.

ddx.dx: Dyserythropoietic pronormoblast in MDS or congenital dyserythropoietic anemia
ddx.vs: Dyserythropoiesis shows nuclear budding, multinuclearity and internuclear bridging across maturation stages rather than giant cells with intranuclear viral inclusions.

64617.recognize_zh: 高倍下骨髓的水腫、疏鬆基質中布滿大量淡藍紫色、細長、平行排列且銳角分枝的絲狀菌絲，夾雜外滲紅血球、棕色含鐵血黃素與散在發炎細胞，符合侵襲性黴菌感染。
features: Numerous slender, pale basophilic filamentous fungal hyphae of fairly uniform narrow width, arranged in roughly parallel radiating arrays
Hyphae show occasional acute-angle branching; septa not clearly resolved on H&E
Loose edematous/necrotic stroma with loss of normal hematopoietic elements
Extravasated red cells and scattered golden-brown hemosiderin-laden macrophages
Scattered small mononuclear inflammatory cells and elongated dark nuclei; bony trabecula at upper right
64617.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy at high power shows loose, edematous to necrotic stroma containing abundant slender, pale basophilic, uniformly narrow filamentous hyphae arranged in roughly parallel arrays with occasional acute-angle branching. There is associated hemorrhage, scattered hemosiderin-laden macrophages and a sparse mononuclear infiltrate, with loss of normal hematopoietic tissue; a bony trabecula is present. Findings are consistent with invasive fungal infection of the bone marrow, with morphology favoring a septate hyaline mould such as Aspergillus; confirmation by GMS/PAS and culture or molecular testing is required.

ddx.vs: Mucorales hyphae are broad (6-25 µm), ribbon-like, pauciseptate and branch at wide or right angles, unlike these narrow uniform acute-branching hyphae.
These septate hyaline moulds are morphologically nearly indistinguishable from Aspergillus in tissue and require culture or molecular identification.
Fibrin and collagen are eosinophilic, wavy and non-branching and do not stain with GMS, whereas hyphae are basophilic tubular structures with branching.
Candida shows constricted pseudohyphae with accompanying small budding yeasts, which are not evident here.

64489.recognize_zh: 腫瘤細胞核深染、多形性，沿著纖維血管軸心排列成類乳突狀，外觀像癌；但 CD138 呈瀰漫膜染色、lambda 輕鏈細胞質強陽性，證明為單株漿細胞腫瘤。
features: Sheets of densely packed neoplastic cells arranged around thin fibrovascular cores, creating a pseudopapillary pattern (A, B)
Hyperchromatic, pleomorphic oval nuclei with irregular nuclear contours and scant pale cytoplasm
No recognizable mature plasma cell morphology (no clock-face chromatin or hof) on H&E
Diffuse strong membranous CD138 expression in tumor cells (C)
Diffuse cytoplasmic lambda light chain expression, indicating monotypic plasma cells (D)
64489.describe_en: Sections of the vertebral lesion show sheets of neoplastic cells arranged around delicate fibrovascular cores, producing a papillary, carcinoma-like architecture. The cells have hyperchromatic, pleomorphic nuclei with irregular contours and scant cytoplasm, without obvious plasmacytic features. By immunohistochemistry, the tumor cells show diffuse membranous CD138 and diffuse cytoplasmic lambda light chain expression. Findings support plasma cell myeloma with unusual papillary architecture mimicking carcinoma.

ddx.vs: Carcinoma is cytokeratin-positive (and GATA3-positive for breast) and lacks light chain restriction, although CD138 can be positive in carcinoma.
Plasmablastic lymphoma shows immunoblastic cells with prominent central nucleoli, very high Ki-67 and frequent EBER positivity, usually without a known myeloma history.
Blastoid mantle cell lymphoma is CD20+, cyclin D1 (BCL1)+ and CD138-negative.

ddx.dx: Neuroendocrine or small round cell tumor
ddx.vs: These express synaptophysin/chromogranin or other lineage markers and lack CD138 with monotypic lambda.

64425.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中高 N:C 比、染色質細緻的母細胞，細胞質內有一顆大而圓、淡紫粉色的包涵體（類 Chediak-Higashi 顆粒）；MPO 染色該包涵體與母細胞皆陰性、PAS 則呈洋紅色陽性，流式細胞儀證實為 B 淋巴母細胞，提醒包涵體不代表骨髓系。
features: Blasts with high N:C ratio, finely dispersed chromatin and scant deeply basophilic cytoplasm (panel A)
Single large round pale pink-violet cytoplasmic inclusion indenting the nucleus (pseudo-Chediak-Higashi-like, arrow)
MPO cytochemistry negative in the blast and its inclusion (panel B)
Core biopsy PAS stain shows discrete magenta PAS-positive cytoplasmic globules in blasts (panel C)
Flow cytometry (panels D-E): CD45-negative (red) and CD45-dim (yellow) blast populations with variable CD34 and CD22 expression
64425.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate shows a predominance of blasts with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio, fine chromatin and scant basophilic cytoplasm; a subset contains a large, round, pale eosinophilic to violet cytoplasmic inclusion resembling a pseudo-Chediak-Higashi granule. The inclusions and blasts are myeloperoxidase-negative, while PAS highlights discrete magenta cytoplasmic globules on the core biopsy. Flow cytometry demonstrates CD45-negative/CD34+ and CD45-dim/CD34- blast populations expressing CD22, with additional cTdT, CD19, cCD79a and PAX5 expression. Findings are consistent with B-lymphoblastic leukemia with eosinophilic (pseudo-Chediak-Higashi-like) cytoplasmic inclusions.

ddx.vs: Pseudo-Chediak-Higashi granules in t(8;21) AML are MPO-positive and accompanied by Auer rods and salmon-colored granules, whereas these inclusions are MPO-negative in TdT+/PAX5+ B-lymphoblasts.
MPAL requires MPO positivity or monocytic differentiation markers; isolated aberrant CD33 with MPO-negative blasts does not establish myeloid lineage.
Congenital Chediak-Higashi shows giant granules in mature neutrophils, lymphocytes and other cells with albinism and immunodeficiency, not restricted to a blast population.

ddx.dx: Blasts with phagocytosed material or overlying platelet
ddx.vs: Phagocytosed debris is irregular and often in a vacuole, while these inclusions are uniform, round, homogeneous and PAS-positive.

64041.recognize_zh: 中央巨核細胞胞質豐富、周邊呈淡粉紫細顆粒狀，中央只有一個圓形、不分葉的深染核（monolobated megakaryocyte），是 MDS del(5q) 的特徵性巨核細胞。
features: Medium-sized megakaryocyte with abundant finely granular pink-purple cytoplasm and a pale peripheral zone
Single central round, non-lobated nucleus with dense chromatin
No nuclear lobation or separated lobes
Background of maturing myeloid precursors (promyelocytes, myelocytes, band neutrophils) and erythroblasts
Scattered platelets; no obvious blast excess in this field
64041.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear (Romanowsky stain, high power) shows a medium-sized megakaryocyte with abundant finely granular cytoplasm and a single, centrally placed, round non-lobated nucleus. The surrounding marrow shows maturing granulocytic precursors and erythroid precursors without an apparent increase in blasts. The monolobated megakaryocyte is the classic morphologic clue to myelodysplastic neoplasm with isolated del(5q). Correlation with karyotype/FISH, blast count and clinical features (macrocytic anemia, normal or increased platelets) is required.

ddx.vs: Micromegakaryocytes are small (<30 um, near promyelocyte size) with a single small nucleus and scant cytoplasm, whereas this cell is medium-sized with abundant cytoplasm.
ET megakaryocytes are large to giant with hyperlobulated nuclei.
Mast cells have coarse metachromatic purple granules obscuring the nucleus and histiocytes have vacuolated cytoplasm, unlike the fine azurophilic granules of megakaryocytes.

63913.recognize_zh: 高倍骨髓抹片充滿中至大型母細胞（箭頭）：核圓或不規則、染色質細緻、有小核仁，細胞質中等量、灰藍色且無顆粒，部分細胞邊緣可見小空泡，這種灰藍無顆粒的外觀是母細胞性漿細胞樣樹突細胞腫瘤（BPDCN）的提示。
features: Numerous medium-to-large blasts with round to irregular nuclei, fine chromatin and small nucleoli
Moderate amount of agranular, pale gray-blue cytoplasm
Occasional small cytoplasmic vacuoles near the cell membrane
Residual erythroid precursors, maturing granulocytes and small lymphocytes
No Auer rods or cytoplasmic granules in the blast population
63913.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear at high power shows an increased population of medium-to-large blasts (arrow) with round to irregular nuclei, finely dispersed chromatin, small nucleoli and moderate agranular gray-blue cytoplasm, a subset with small peripheral vacuoles. Residual erythroid precursors, granulocytes and lymphocytes are present. Auer rods and granules are absent. Morphology is not specific, and diagnosis requires demonstration of CD123, TCL1, CD4 and CD56 expression without myeloid lineage markers. Findings are compatible with blastic plasmacytoid dendritic cell neoplasm in the appropriate immunophenotypic context.

ddx.vs: Monoblasts/myeloblasts may show granules, Auer rods, MPO or nonspecific esterase positivity, whereas BPDCN blasts are agranular, cytochemically negative and TCL1/CD123-bright.
Lymphoblasts have scantier cytoplasm and express TdT with B/T lineage markers rather than CD4/CD56/CD123/TCL1.
AML with CD4 or CD56 expression retains CD34, CD117 or MPO, which are usually negative in BPDCN.
NK neoplasms are CD56-positive but CD123/TCL1-negative and often show azurophilic granules and EBV positivity.

63849.recognize_zh: 這是未染色的濕式玻片，加入 2% 偏亞硫酸氫鈉（sodium metabisulphite）去氧後，大多數紅血球變成新月形、鐮刀形或冬青葉狀（holly-leaf），代表鐮刀化試驗陽性，表示檢體含 HbS。
features: Unstained wet preparation viewed by bright-field microscopy with refractile, pale green-grey red cells
Majority of red cells transformed into crescent, sickle and holly-leaf shapes with pointed projections
Some cells with filamentous tails and curved boat-like outlines
Only a minority of round, unsickled red cells remain
No staining; image resolution limits fine cellular detail
63849.describe_en: Wet preparation of whole blood incubated with 2% sodium metabisulphite shows that most red cells have transformed into sickle, crescent and holly-leaf forms with pointed projections, with only occasional round cells remaining. This constitutes a positive sickling test, indicating the presence of HbS. The test does not distinguish sickle cell trait from HbSS, HbSC, HbS/beta-thalassemia or HbSD, so quantitation by HPLC or electrophoresis is required. In this index case, findings support an HbS-containing genotype, subsequently characterized as HbSD disease.

ddx.dx: False-positive sickling from drying or crenation artifact
ddx.vs: Artifactual crenated or dried cells show spiculated echinocytes or randomly deformed cells at the slide edges without the uniform crescent and holly-leaf transformation seen after sealed deoxygenation.
HbD and HbE traits or homozygotes are sickling-negative, so a positive test requires an HbS (or rare HbC-Harlem) component.

ddx.dx: Sickle cell trait vs sickling disease
ddx.vs: Both yield positive sickling tests, and only hemoglobin fractionation (HbA > HbS in trait, no HbA in SS/SD/S-beta0) separates them.

63785.recognize_zh: 抹片背景明顯偏藍灰色，紅血球在單層區仍疊成鏈狀與分枝狀的 rouleaux，是血清中大量副蛋白（paraprotein）的線索，符合多發性骨髓瘤。
features: Diffuse blue-gray background staining throughout the smear
Marked rouleaux with red cells in linear and branching stacks
One eosinophil with bilobed nucleus and orange granules
One mononuclear cell with round nucleus, coarse chromatin and moderate purple cytoplasm, not definitively a plasma cell at this resolution
Scattered platelets
63785.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows diffuse bluish background staining and marked rouleaux formation, with red cells arranged in linear and branching stacks. An eosinophil and a single mononuclear cell with a round nucleus and moderate cytoplasm are present; the latter cannot be confidently classified as a plasma cell at this resolution. Platelets are present. These findings reflect increased serum protein, most often a monoclonal immunoglobulin, and are suggestive of plasma cell myeloma in the appropriate clinical setting; correlate with serum protein electrophoresis and immunofixation.

ddx.vs: Agglutination produces irregular grape-like clusters instead of coin stacks and resolves with warming of the sample.

ddx.dx: Artifactual rouleaux in thick smear area
ddx.vs: Artifact is confined to the thick area and lacks the blue background staining, whereas true rouleaux persist in the thin monolayer.
May cause rouleaux, but serum studies show a polyclonal increase without an M-spike.
Would show numerous circulating plasma cells (≥5% of leukocytes by current criteria), which are not evident here.

63657.recognize_zh: 巨噬細胞的細胞質中有數十顆卵圓形小體（約 2–4 µm），多數可見一個紫色圓核，部分旁邊還有更小、顏色更深的棒狀動基體（kinetoplast），周圍沒有透明暈，符合利什曼原蟲無鞭毛體（amastigote）。
features: Large macrophage with round-oval eccentric nucleus and abundant pale blue cytoplasm
Dozens of small oval intracytoplasmic organisms (approximately 2-4 µm) with pale cytoplasm
Each organism has a purple nucleus; several show a smaller, darker rod-shaped kinetoplast
No clear halo or capsule around the organisms
Background red cells and scattered platelets
63657.describe_en: Bone marrow smear shows a large macrophage with an eccentric nucleus and abundant cytoplasm containing numerous small, oval intracellular organisms approximately 2-4 µm in size. Many organisms display a round nucleus accompanied by a smaller, dark rod-shaped kinetoplast, and no surrounding clear halo is seen. Findings are consistent with Leishmania amastigotes (visceral leishmaniasis); species confirmation by PCR or culture is recommended.

ddx.vs: Histoplasma yeasts have a single crescent-shaped staining body with a clear halo, no kinetoplast, and are GMS/PAS positive.
Toxoplasma tachyzoites are crescentic and lack a kinetoplast.
T. cruzi amastigotes also have a kinetoplast but are typically found in cardiac or skeletal muscle and are separated by serology, PCR, and epidemiology.
Platelets are anucleate granular fragments in a different focal plane without the nucleus-kinetoplast pair.

63529.recognize_zh: 普魯士藍（Prussian blue）染色的骨髓抹片中，多顆巨噬細胞內充滿大塊深藍色含鐵血黃素，背景也散布大量藍色鐵顆粒，表示骨髓鐵儲存明顯增加；配合低鐵飽和度與高鐵蛋白，符合慢性病貧血。
features: Multiple macrophages containing coarse, confluent dark blue hemosiderin deposits
Abundant scattered blue iron granules within marrow particles and background
Iron stores graded as markedly increased (grade 5-6 range) in this field
Nuclear fast red counterstain highlights background nucleated cells and red cells
Individual erythroid precursors cannot be assessed for siderotic granules at this magnification
63529.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear stained with Prussian blue (Perls) shows a cellular particle containing numerous macrophages laden with coarse, confluent blue hemosiderin, along with abundant extracellular and scattered intracellular iron granules. Storage iron is markedly increased. Sideroblastic iron in erythroid precursors cannot be adequately evaluated at this magnification, and no ring sideroblasts can be assessed. In the setting of low transferrin saturation and elevated ferritin and hepcidin, findings are consistent with iron-restricted erythropoiesis with increased reticuloendothelial iron stores as seen in anemia of chronic disease.

ddx.vs: Iron deficiency shows absent stainable macrophage iron, whereas here macrophage iron stores are markedly increased.
Iron overload shows increased stores together with high transferrin saturation and parenchymal iron, whereas the transferrin saturation here is low.
Ring sideroblasts require high-power evaluation of erythroid precursors showing perinuclear granules encircling at least one-third of the nucleus, which is not demonstrated in this field.

ddx.dx: Anemia of chronic disease with coexistent iron deficiency
ddx.vs: Combined deficiency shows reduced or absent marrow iron and lower ferritin, unlike the abundant storage iron seen here.

63465.recognize_zh: 周邊血液抹片中央一個比紅血球大、深紫色、分葉狀的濃縮細胞核，周圍幾乎沒有細胞質，也沒有顆粒，就是巨核細胞的裸核（bare megakaryocyte nucleus）。
features: Isolated nucleus about 2 times red cell diameter with essentially no surrounding cytoplasm
Dense, dark purple, hyperchromatic chromatin with a lobulated/folded outline
Faint internal clefts between lobes; no nucleoli
No cytoplasmic granules or platelet budding attached
Background red cells with mild poikilocytosis and a fragmented/crenated red cell below
63465.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a single dense, dark-staining lobulated nucleus approximately twice the size of a red cell, devoid of visible cytoplasm. The chromatin is condensed and folded with faint internal clefts, and no nucleoli, granules, or attached platelet fragments are seen. Surrounding red cells show only mild poikilocytosis. Findings are consistent with a bare (naked) megakaryocyte nucleus, which may be seen in small numbers in normal blood, especially in buffy coat preparations, and becomes significant when numerous as in myelofibrosis.

ddx.vs: Smudge cells are flattened, pale, and structureless with smeared chromatin, whereas this nucleus is compact, hyperchromatic, and lobulated.
Micromegakaryocytes retain a rim of granular or basophilic cytoplasm, often with platelet budding, which is absent here.
Lymphocytes have a round nucleus with a thin rim of blue cytoplasm and are about red cell size, rather than being a larger folded nucleus without cytoplasm.
nRBCs have a round, smaller, extremely dense nucleus surrounded by pink hemoglobinized cytoplasm.

63401.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中可見成片、界線不清的上皮樣組織球（epithelioid histiocyte），核呈卵圓至拉長、染色質淡、細胞質粉紅豐富，其間夾雜淋巴球與漿細胞，是界線不清的肉芽腫；此倍率下看不到壞死或菌體。
features: Ill-defined aggregates of epithelioid histiocytes with oval to elongated, vesicular, slipper-shaped nuclei and abundant pale eosinophilic cytoplasm
Admixed small lymphocytes, plasma cells and scattered granulocytes
No well-formed discrete granuloma border, caseous necrosis or definite multinucleated giant cells in this field
Residual hematopoietic cells and fat spaces at the periphery
Fungal organisms not identifiable on H&E at this magnification
63401.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy shows ill-defined aggregates of epithelioid histiocytes with oval to elongated vesicular nuclei and abundant pale eosinophilic cytoplasm, admixed with lymphocytes, plasma cells and scattered granulocytes. Discrete well-formed granulomas, necrosis and multinucleated giant cells are not evident in this field, and organisms cannot be identified on H&E. Residual hematopoietic elements and fat spaces are present. Findings are consistent with ill-defined granulomatous inflammation of the marrow; GMS, PAS and AFB stains with culture are recommended to evaluate for fungal or mycobacterial infection.

ddx.vs: Tuberculous granulomas are more often well formed with caseous necrosis and Langhans giant cells, and AFB staining or culture separates it from fungal infection.
Sarcoid granulomas are tight, well circumscribed and non-necrotizing with few surrounding lymphocytes, and special stains for organisms are negative.
Hodgkin lymphoma shows scattered large Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells (CD30+, CD15+) in a mixed inflammatory and fibrotic background.
Lipogranulomas are small histiocytic aggregates centered on lipid vacuoles and are incidental, unlike the sheets of epithelioid cells here.

63337.recognize_zh: 中倍視野中巨核細胞數量增加並鬆散成群，核濃染、形狀扭曲，背景為纖維化基質，細胞呈流線狀排列並有出血與含鐵血黃素；在 PV 病史下符合 post-PV myelofibrosis。
features: Increased megakaryocytes forming loose clusters
Megakaryocytes with hyperchromatic, irregular and clumped nuclei; size variation
Fibrotic eosinophilic stroma with streaming of spindle cells and small hematopoietic cells
Granulocytic cells present; erythroid islands not prominent
Focal hemorrhage with hemosiderin and scattered fat spaces; bone trabecula at upper left
63337.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy at intermediate power shows increased megakaryocytes forming loose clusters, with hyperchromatic, irregular and clumped nuclei. The megakaryocytes lie within a fibrotic stroma showing streaming of spindle and hematopoietic cells, with granulocytic cells, inconspicuous erythroid islands, focal hemorrhage and hemosiderin. Reticulin/trichrome staining is needed to grade fibrosis. In a patient with polycythemia vera, findings are consistent with post-polycythemic myelofibrosis.

ddx.vs: Morphology overlaps completely; distinction requires a prior diagnosis of PV.

ddx.dx: Reactive marrow fibrosis (e.g., infection, autoimmune myelofibrosis)
ddx.vs: Reactive fibrosis lacks clustered atypical hyperchromatic megakaryocytes and shows polyclonal lymphoid aggregates without a driver mutation.
Metastatic tumor shows cohesive nests of keratin-positive cells rather than megakaryocytes in the fibrotic stroma.

63273.recognize_zh: 這是示意長條圖而非形態圖：上排代表唐氏症（DS）新生兒中僅一小部分發生 TAM，中排代表 TAM 病人中一部分後來進展為唐氏症相關骨髓性白血病（ML-DS），下方標示其中 70% 為急性巨核母細胞白血病（AMKL）。
features: Schematic horizontal bar diagram, not a morphologic image
Top bar: Down syndrome (DS) population with a small terminal segment labeled TAM
Middle bar: TAM population expanded, with a segment labeled ML-DS (myeloid leukemia of Down syndrome)
Bottom box under ML-DS: '70% are AMKL' (acute megakaryoblastic leukemia)
Bars illustrate nested proportions and are not drawn to exact scale
63273.describe_en: This figure is a schematic summary rather than a morphologic image. It shows that transient abnormal myelopoiesis (TAM) arises in a minority of neonates with Down syndrome, that a subset of patients with TAM later develop myeloid leukemia associated with Down syndrome (ML-DS), and that about 70% of ML-DS cases are acute megakaryoblastic leukemia. It should be interpreted as a conceptual illustration of the natural history (TAM, often spontaneously regressing, followed in some patients by ML-DS within the first years of life) rather than a precise quantitative graph.

63209.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片四格中可見大片不規則、雲絮狀、質地蓬鬆的淡紫至紫色無定形沉積物，邊緣呈羽毛狀、內部沒有細胞核，周圍散布淋巴球、髓系細胞與少數漿細胞；這種 cloud-like 物質是類澱粉在抹片上的樣貌。
features: Large irregular extracellular aggregates of amorphous, fluffy, cloud-like lilac to purple material
Deposits have feathery, finely granular edges and contain no nuclei or cell membranes
Lymphocytes, myeloid cells and occasional plasma cells lie adjacent to or trapped within the deposits
Background red cells in thicker smear areas
63209.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smears (composite of four fields) show multiple large, irregular extracellular aggregates of amorphous, fluffy, cloud-like lilac to purple material with feathery granular borders and no internal nuclei. Lymphocytes, maturing myeloid cells and occasional plasma cells are present around and within the deposits. The appearance is suggestive of amyloid; because fibrin, precipitated protein or crushed cells can look similar on smears, confirmation with Congo red staining (apple-green birefringence) on particles, clot section or biopsy is required. Findings are suggestive of bone marrow involvement by amyloidosis.

ddx.vs: Fibrin is fibrillar and platelet aggregates retain granular platelet texture, typically in partially clotted samples, and both are Congo red negative.
Precipitate is dark, crystalline or granular, lies in a different focal plane and is not intimately associated with cells.
Crushed megakaryocytes retain granular cytoplasm with nuclear fragments, and smudge cells show residual nuclear chromatin strands.

63145.recognize_zh: 一顆小到中型淋巴球，核中央有深凹陷而呈腎形／雙葉狀，染色質緻密、核仁不明顯、細胞質稀少淡藍，是 Sézary 細胞核輪廓不規則的表現。
features: Small-to-intermediate lymphocyte, slightly larger than a red cell
Deeply indented, bilobed/reniform nucleus with irregular folded contour
Dense hyperchromatic chromatin, no visible nucleoli
Scant pale-blue agranular cytoplasm, high N:C ratio
Background normal-appearing red cells and a few platelets
63145.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a small-to-intermediate lymphocyte with a deeply indented, bilobed nucleus with an irregular folded contour, dense chromatin, no visible nucleoli, and a thin rim of pale agranular cytoplasm. Background red cells and platelets are unremarkable. The fine cerebriform grooves are not well resolved in this image. Findings are compatible with a Sézary cell in the setting of the documented CD4+CD7−CD26− T-cell population.

ddx.vs: ATLL flower cells are multilobated with a petal-like configuration and are CD25 bright with HTLV-1 positivity.
Occasional cleaved reactive lymphocytes occur, but they are few and not accompanied by a clonal antigen-deficient CD4+ population.
Buttock cells have a single sharp cleft and are B cells (CD10+, CD20+) rather than CD4+ T cells.
Monocytes are larger with abundant grey-blue vacuolated cytoplasm and lacy, folded chromatin.

63081.recognize_zh: 這不是顯微鏡影像，而是手繪示意圖「Figure 1B」：血管內皮活化，白血球、紅血球、血小板黏附於血管壁，並有 NETs、血小板-白血球聚集體、微粒、凝血酶與細胞激素；用來說明 MPN 的血栓發炎狀態。注意此圖實為 Figure 1B，並非標題與說明所指的 Figure 2。
features: Hand-drawn schematic of a blood vessel lumen labeled FIGURE 1B
Activated endothelial cells lining both walls with adherent leukocytes, red cells and platelets
Neutrophil extracellular traps (NETs) and platelet-leukocyte aggregates within the lumen
Circulating microparticles, thrombin (TH) and cytokines (X) depicted
Legend defines each symbol
63081.describe_en: This is a non-morphologic, hand-drawn schematic (labeled Figure 1B) rather than a microscopic image. It depicts a blood vessel in which activated endothelial cells bind activated leukocytes, red cells and platelets, with neutrophil extracellular traps, platelet-leukocyte aggregates, microparticles, thrombin generation and cytokine release in the lumen. It illustrates the prothrombotic, pro-adhesive thromboinflammatory milieu in myeloproliferative neoplasms. Note that the image corresponds to Figure 1B, whereas the record title and description refer to Figure 2 (the CHIP/MPN/inflammation flow diagram).

63017.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中混有粒細胞系與紅血球前驅細胞，其間可見數個胞質豐富、灰藍色、核偏心的大型漿細胞，部分有核旁淡染區；漿細胞明顯增加且型態偏大、偏不成熟，符合漿細胞骨髓瘤。
features: Several large plasma cells with abundant gray-blue cytoplasm and eccentric round nuclei
Perinuclear hof visible in some plasma cells; chromatin moderately fine
Plasma cells admixed with granulocytic precursors, bands and segmented neutrophils
Erythroid precursors with dense round nuclei present in the center
Photograph slightly out of focus, limiting assessment of nucleoli and inclusions
63017.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear (Romanowsky stain) shows a cellular field containing granulocytic precursors, segmented neutrophils, and erythroid precursors, together with several increased large plasma cells. The plasma cells have abundant gray-blue cytoplasm, eccentric round nuclei with moderately fine chromatin, and focal perinuclear hofs. The image is slightly out of focus, which limits evaluation of nucleoli and cytoplasmic inclusions. Findings are consistent with involvement by plasma cell myeloma in the context of a reported 60% marrow plasma cells and a monoclonal protein.

ddx.vs: Reactive plasma cells are small and mature with coarse chromatin, usually below 10% and polytypic by light chain studies.
Osteoblasts also have eccentric nuclei and a pale zone, but are larger, comet-shaped, occur in small sheets, and the pale zone lies away from the nucleus.
LPL shows a continuum of small lymphocytes and plasmacytoid lymphocytes with IgM paraprotein and MYD88 L265P rather than large immature plasma cells.

62953.recognize_zh: 低倍下整個視野被單一形態、密集的小至中型淋巴細胞瀰漫性取代，看不到反應性濾泡或生發中心，中間殘留一條透明化（hyalinized）的血管與間質，符合被套細胞淋巴瘤（mantle cell lymphoma）的瀰漫生長型態。
features: Diffuse, effacing proliferation of monotonous small-to-intermediate lymphoid cells
No residual reactive follicles or germinal centers identified in the field
Vaguely nodular areas without distinct mantle or marginal zones
Central hyalinized vessel with perivascular sclerosis and a small entrapped lymphoid focus
Scattered brown pigment granules; no starry-sky pattern discernible at this magnification
62953.describe_en: Low-power H&E section shows effacement of the architecture by a diffuse to vaguely nodular, monotonous lymphoid infiltrate. No residual reactive follicles or germinal centers are seen, and a hyalinized vessel with perivascular sclerosis is present centrally. Cytologic detail cannot be assessed at this magnification. In the context of cyclin D1 positivity, findings are consistent with involvement by mantle cell lymphoma.

ddx.vs: SLL shows pale proliferation centers with prolymphocytes and paraimmunoblasts and is LEF1+/cyclin D1-, whereas MCL lacks proliferation centers and is cyclin D1+/SOX11+.
FL forms back-to-back neoplastic follicles of centrocytes and centroblasts that are CD10+/BCL6+ and CD5-, unlike the diffuse CD5+ cyclin D1+ MCL infiltrate.
NMZL has monocytoid cells with pale cytoplasm around residual follicles, often with plasmacytic differentiation, and is CD5- and cyclin D1-.

62825.recognize_zh: p120 免疫染色下，幾乎所有腫瘤細胞呈瀰漫性胞質染色合併清楚的細胞膜陽性，細胞圓形、彼此鬆散；正常上皮 p120 只在細胞膜，胞質染色代表 E-cadherin 缺失，是乳小葉癌（lobular carcinoma）的特徵。
features: IHC for p120 catenin on a marrow core diffusely replaced by tumor
Round discohesive tumor cells with diffuse cytoplasmic staining plus accentuated membranous rims
Unstained round-to-oval nuclei, some eccentric, conferring a plasmacytoid look
Only rare interspersed negative cells with blue nuclei
Loose arrangement without gland formation
62825.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain for p120 catenin on the bone marrow core shows diffuse replacement by round, discohesive tumor cells with strong diffuse cytoplasmic staining and accentuated membranous rims. Rare interspersed non-neoplastic cells are negative, and no gland formation is seen. Cytoplasmic relocalization of p120 reflects loss of E-cadherin-mediated adhesion. Findings support metastatic lobular carcinoma of the breast.

ddx.dx: Metastatic ductal (no special type) breast carcinoma
ddx.vs: Ductal carcinoma retains E-cadherin, so p120 is purely membranous rather than diffusely cytoplasmic.
Myeloma is cytokeratin, GATA3 and E-cadherin/p120 negative in this pattern and shows kappa or lambda restriction.
Gastric signet ring carcinoma can also show CDH1 loss and cytoplasmic p120 but is GATA3 and ER negative and often CDX2 positive.

62761.recognize_zh: 整個視野中大量紅血球邊緣有半圓形咬痕缺口（bite cells）或一側透明的水泡狀區（blister cells），並夾雜球形紅血球與棘突狀紅血球，提示藥物（dapsone）引起的氧化性溶血。
features: Numerous bite cells with semicircular peripheral notches and hemoglobin-free defects
Blister cells with hemoglobin retracted to one side and a pale vesicular edge
Scattered small dense spherocytic cells lacking central pallor
Keratocyte/spiculated forms and occasional echinocytes
Platelets present; residual normal discocytes with central pallor
62761.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows marked poikilocytosis dominated by numerous bite cells with semicircular peripheral defects and blister cells with eccentrically retracted hemoglobin. Scattered small dense spherocytic cells and spiculated forms are also present, while residual red cells retain normal central pallor. Platelets are adequate in this field. Findings are consistent with oxidative hemolysis, compatible with dapsone toxicity in the given clinical context; a Heinz body preparation, methemoglobin level and G6PD assay are recommended.

ddx.vs: Smear morphology is indistinguishable; G6PD enzyme activity (measured after reticulocytosis subsides) and drug history separate them.
HS shows uniform spherocytes without bite or blister cells and has a positive EMA-binding or osmotic fragility test.
MAHA fragments are helmet and triangular schistocytes with straight cut edges accompanied by thrombocytopenia rather than rounded bite defects.
Unstable hemoglobins produce similar bite cells and Heinz bodies but are chronic and detected by isopropanol stability testing and hemoglobin analysis.

62697.recognize_zh: 活細胞的 CD3 對側向散射流式圖：方框內 CD3 陽性 T 細胞（藍色）僅占 22.63%，其左側有一大群低 SS、CD3 陰性到弱的綠色 NK 細胞，數量與 T 細胞相當，顯示 NK 細胞增加。
features: Dot plot of living cells: CD3-PC5.5 (x) versus side scatter (y)
Boxed CD3-positive, low SS T-cell gate (blue) 22.63% of living cells
Large green low-SS population CD3 negative to dim (below the T-cell gate), comparable in size to T cells, consistent with NK cells
Magenta CD3-negative low-SS population (B cells) at left
Orange intermediate-SS monocytes and dark gray high-SS granulocytes CD3 negative
62697.describe_en: Flow cytometric CD3 versus side scatter plot of living cells shows CD3-positive T cells comprising 22.63% of events within the boxed gate. A prominent low side scatter CD3-negative population (green), consistent with NK cells and comparable in size to the T-cell population, lies immediately to the left of the gate, together with a smaller CD3-negative B-cell population and CD3-negative monocytes and granulocytes. The expanded CD3-negative lymphoid population indicates that the lymphocytosis is not T-cell derived. Findings are consistent with the reported chronic lymphoproliferative disorder of NK cells.

ddx.vs: T-LGL expands the CD3-positive gate, whereas here the expanded low-SS population is CD3 negative.
CLL expands a CD3-negative population, but those cells are CD19/CD5/CD23-positive B cells rather than CD56/CD57-positive NK cells.
The phenotype is shared; persistence over 6 months and KIR restriction favor a clonal NK-cell disorder.

62633.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中骨小樑旁的造血組織細胞密度高，可見大量核圓深染、周圍有透明暈的紅系前驅細胞與較大、染色質較開放的前驅細胞，間有散在深褐黑色顆粒狀色素沉積；PNH 骨髓可呈細胞增多、紅系增生，也可能是低增生的。
features: Bony trabecula at left with adjacent hypercellular hematopoietic marrow
Numerous erythroid precursors with round, dark nuclei and perinuclear clear halos, some in clusters
Admixed larger precursors with open chromatin and small nucleoli; arrow marks a paratrabecular group of such cells
Scattered coarse dark brown-black granular pigment deposits (hemosiderin versus formalin pigment)
Interstitial hemorrhage/extravasated red cells and scattered fat vacuoles
62633.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy section shows a bony trabecula with adjacent hypercellular hematopoietic marrow. There are numerous erythroid precursors with round dark nuclei and perinuclear halos, admixed with larger precursors with open chromatin and small nucleoli; the arrow marks a paratrabecular group of these cells. Scattered coarse dark brown-black granular pigment deposits and interstitial extravasated red cells are present; the pigment should be characterized with an iron stain because it may represent hemosiderin or formalin pigment. Findings suggest a hypercellular marrow with erythroid hyperplasia, compatible with a hemolytic state such as paroxysmal nocturnal hemoglobinuria; morphology is nonspecific and a CD34 stain helps exclude increased blasts.

ddx.vs: Shows dysplastic megakaryocytes, abnormally localized immature precursors and increased CD34-positive blasts, rather than orderly erythroid hyperplasia.
Sheets of immature pronormoblasts with high N:C ratio and fine chromatin, often with TP53 mutation, rather than maturing erythroid precursors.

ddx.dx: Reactive erythroid hyperplasia from other hemolysis or blood loss
ddx.vs: Morphologically identical; separated by clinical and laboratory findings such as DAT and FLAER flow cytometry.

62505.recognize_zh: 骨小樑旁的骨髓腔被大量小而圓、染色質深的成熟小淋巴球間質性浸潤，殘存造血細胞被擠散，符合慢性淋巴球性白血病（CLL）骨髓侵犯。
features: Numerous small, mature-appearing lymphocytes only slightly larger than red cells
High N:C ratio with round, dark nuclei and condensed chromatin; nucleoli inconspicuous
Scant cytoplasm
Interstitial to diffuse infiltrate displacing residual hematopoietic cells (scattered larger myeloid/erythroid precursors)
Bony trabecula at upper right confirms a trephine biopsy
62505.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy at high power shows a dense interstitial-to-diffuse infiltrate of small, round lymphocytes with condensed chromatin, inconspicuous nucleoli and scant cytoplasm, adjacent to a bony trabecula. Residual trilineage hematopoietic elements are scattered between the lymphoid cells. No sheets of large transformed cells are seen in this field. Findings are consistent with marrow involvement by chronic lymphocytic leukemia/small lymphocytic lymphoma; immunophenotyping is required for confirmation.

ddx.vs: Mantle cell lymphoma cells tend to have more irregular, cleaved nuclei and are cyclin D1/SOX11 positive, whereas CLL cells are round and LEF1/CD23 positive.
Marginal zone lymphoma often forms intrasinusoidal or paratrabecular nodules of cells with more abundant pale cytoplasm and is CD5/CD23 negative.
Reactive aggregates are small, well-circumscribed, non-paratrabecular and polytypic with mixed T and B cells, unlike this extensive interstitial infiltrate.

62441.recognize_zh: 視野中並列兩顆嗜中性球，每顆核都分成 6 葉以上，葉間以細染色質絲相連，背景紅血球偏大，符合巨母細胞性貧血的過度分葉嗜中性球。
features: Two adjacent neutrophils, each with a nucleus of six or more lobes
Lobes connected by fine chromatin filaments; clumped mature chromatin
Cytoplasm with fine pink-lilac granules; no toxic granulation or Dohle bodies
Background red cells relatively large with some oval forms; a few platelets present
62441.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows two neutrophils with marked nuclear hypersegmentation, each nucleus composed of six or more lobes connected by thin chromatin strands. Cytoplasmic granulation is unremarkable without toxic changes. Background erythrocytes appear relatively large with occasional oval forms. Findings are consistent with hypersegmented neutrophils, suggestive of megaloblastic anemia due to vitamin B12 or folate deficiency.

ddx.vs: Normal neutrophils have 3-4 lobes, and six or more lobes in any cell is abnormal.
Morphology is indistinguishable, so medication history and normal B12/folate levels are needed.
MDS more often shows hypogranular or hyposegmented (pseudo-Pelger) neutrophils together with cytopenias and marrow dysplasia, and B12/folate are normal.

ddx.dx: Iron deficiency or renal failure-associated hypersegmentation
ddx.vs: Hypersegmentation can occur in these settings but with microcytic or normocytic red cells rather than macro-ovalocytes.

62377.recognize_zh: 流式細胞儀母細胞閘中 CD13 對 CD11b 作圖，大部分母細胞 CD13 陽性但 CD11b 陰性，只有 16.41% 為 CD13+CD11b+，顯示母細胞缺乏成熟（單核球/顆粒球）標記。
features: Dot plot gated on blasts: CD13-PE (y-axis) versus CD11b-APC750 (x-axis)
Main cluster is CD13-positive and CD11b-negative (upper-left quadrant, percentage not labeled)
Minor CD13+CD11b+ subset (16.41%) and rare CD13-CD11b+ events (1.34%)
Separate CD13-negative, CD11b-negative population in the lower-left quadrant
62377.describe_en: Flow cytometric dot plot gated on blasts shows CD13 versus CD11b. The predominant population is CD13-positive and CD11b-negative, with only a minor CD13+CD11b+ fraction (16.41%) and rare CD11b-only events (1.34%). This indicates an immature myeloid phenotype without substantial monocytic or granulocytic maturation-associated CD11b acquisition. The plot supports a myeloid blast population but is not specific for AML with inv(3)/t(3;3).

ddx.vs: Monocytic leukemias acquire CD11b, CD14, CD64 and CD36 on the leukemic population, whereas these blasts are predominantly CD11b-negative.
Normal maturing myeloid cells show an ordered CD13/CD11b maturation curve rather than a discrete CD11b-negative blast cluster.

62313.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中 CD20 呈瀰漫性強陽性取代造血組織，TRAP 免疫染色大片陽性，annexin A1 在腫瘤細胞呈陽性，這組免疫染色組合指向毛狀細胞白血病（HCL）。
features: CD20: diffuse, strong membranous staining of a hypercellular interstitial-to-diffuse infiltrate replacing most marrow space
TRAP immunostain: diffuse positivity in the majority of infiltrating cells
Annexin A1: positive cytoplasmic/membranous staining in most infiltrating cells, with a small negative cluster of residual cells
Scattered strongly annexin A1-positive myeloid cells serve as internal positive control
Infiltrate cells spaced apart with a 'fried-egg' pattern, residual fat spaces preserved
62313.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stains on the bone marrow core biopsy show a diffuse infiltrate of B cells that are strongly positive for CD20 and replace most of the hematopoietic space. The infiltrating cells are diffusely positive for TRAP and positive for annexin A1, while a small cluster of residual annexin A1-negative cells and scattered strongly positive myeloid elements (internal control) are present. This immunoprofile (CD20+, TRAP+, annexin A1+) is consistent with bone marrow involvement by hairy cell leukemia.

ddx.vs: SMZL is CD20+ but typically shows an intrasinusoidal/nodular pattern and is negative for annexin A1 and usually TRAP.
HCL-v is CD20+ but annexin A1 negative, often TRAP weak/negative, and lacks CD25 and BRAF V600E.
Mast cell infiltrates can mimic the clear-cell pattern and are TRAP-reactive, but are CD20-negative and CD117/tryptase positive.

62249.recognize_zh: CK5/6 染色勾勒出網狀、分支的棕色上皮網絡，包住胸腺小葉周邊並形成小的上皮巢，而甲狀腺濾泡上皮陰性，證實淋巴組織中存在胸腺上皮支架。
features: Strong cytoplasmic/membranous CK5/6 staining of a reticular, anastomosing epithelial network outlining the thymic lobules
Epithelial cells rim the lobules and extend as branching cords and small nests into the surrounding tissue
Occasional denser epithelial aggregates within the network (possible Hassall corpuscle/medullary epithelium)
Enmeshed lymphocytes are negative and appear blue
Thyroid follicles are CK5/6-negative
62249.describe_en: CK5/6 immunohistochemistry highlights a delicate, branching reticular network of epithelial cells that encloses and permeates the lymphoid lobules, with additional small cords and nests at the periphery. The entrapped lymphocytes and the intermixed thyroid follicles are negative. This preserved lace-like epithelial meshwork is characteristic of thymic tissue. Findings are consistent with a cervical thymic remnant with intermixed ectopic thyroid tissue.

ddx.vs: Lymphoblastic lymphoma shows sheets of TdT-positive cells with absent or disrupted keratin-positive epithelium, whereas a normal thymus retains an intact CK5/6-positive reticular meshwork.
Metastatic carcinoma forms cohesive atypical keratin-positive nests replacing nodal parenchyma rather than a fine, evenly distributed reticular network.
Thymoma shows an expanded, abnormally lobulated keratin-positive epithelial network in an encapsulated mass, unlike this small organized remnant.

62185.recognize_zh: 數顆體積約為旁邊小淋巴球三倍的大型淋巴樣細胞，細胞質深藍、染色質細緻並可見核仁，其中一顆帶細胞質空泡；背景仍有小型成熟 CLL 細胞，符合 CLL 轉化為瀰漫性大 B 細胞淋巴瘤（Richter transformation）的表現。
features: Large lymphoid cells about three times the diameter of small lymphocytes
Abundant, deeply basophilic cytoplasm with a scalloped border
Round to slightly irregular nuclei with fine dispersed chromatin and visible nucleoli
One large cell with multiple clear cytoplasmic vacuoles
Admixed small mature lymphocytes with dense chromatin; red cells unremarkable
62185.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a population of large atypical lymphoid cells admixed with small mature lymphocytes. The large cells have abundant deeply basophilic cytoplasm, round to slightly irregular nuclei with finely dispersed chromatin and visible nucleoli, and one contains several cytoplasmic vacuoles. The small lymphocytes have condensed chromatin typical of CLL cells. Findings are suggestive of large-cell transformation of CLL (Richter transformation, DLBCL type), to be confirmed by tissue biopsy and clonal relationship studies.

ddx.vs: Burkitt cells are medium-sized, monotonous with many vacuoles in deeply basophilic cytoplasm and MYC rearrangement, without a small CLL cell background.
Prolymphocytes are smaller with a single prominent nucleolus, moderately condensed chromatin and less cytoplasm than these large transformed cells.
Blasts have scant cytoplasm and very fine chromatin with CD34/TdT or myeloid markers, whereas DLBCL cells are mature B cells (CD20+, TdT−).
Immunoblasts appear in viral infections as a polyclonal heterogeneous population with plasmacytoid features, not in a clonal CLL background.

62121.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片可見成群漿細胞、雙核漿細胞與含葡萄狀包涵體的 Mott 細胞；切片 CD138 顯示漿細胞增加，但 kappa 與 lambda 皆有表現（多株性），淋巴結則被漿細胞片狀浸潤，符合特發性漿細胞性淋巴結病而非漿細胞骨髓瘤。
features: Aspirate with clusters of mature plasma cells with eccentric nuclei, perinuclear hofs and deep blue cytoplasm (A, B)
Occasional binucleate plasma cells and a Mott cell with grape-like Russell body inclusions (B, C)
Plasma cells with multiple cytoplasmic vacuoles (D)
Marrow biopsy with interstitial plasma cells (arrows) on H&E (E)
CD138 highlighting increased interstitial plasma cells, with both kappa and lambda expression indicating polytypia (F, G)
Lymph node with sheets of mature plasma cells in the interfollicular areas (H)
62121.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smears (A-D) show increased mature-appearing plasma cells in clusters, including binucleate forms, Mott cells with Russell bodies and vacuolated plasma cells, without prominent nucleoli or plasmablastic cytology. The trephine biopsy (E) shows interstitial plasma cells, and CD138 (F) highlights their increase, while kappa and lambda studies (G) show a mixture of both light chains, indicating a polytypic population. The lymph node (H) shows sheet-like interfollicular plasmacytosis. Findings are consistent with a reactive polyclonal plasmacytosis, supporting idiopathic plasmacytic lymphadenopathy with polyclonal hypergammaglobulinemia rather than plasma cell myeloma.

ddx.vs: Myeloma shows light-chain restricted (monotypic) plasma cells with a serum M-protein, whereas kappa and lambda are both expressed here.
IgG4-related disease has elevated serum IgG4 with IgG4-positive plasma cells above 40% of IgG-positive cells, which requires IgG4 immunostaining.
Idiopathic multicentric Castleman disease shows regressed or hyperplastic follicles with interfollicular plasmacytosis plus systemic inflammatory criteria and is HHV-8 negative.
LPL shows a light-chain restricted spectrum of small lymphocytes and plasmacytoid cells with MYD88 L265P and an IgM paraprotein.

62121.stain: Wright-Giemsa; H&E; IHC: CD138; ISH: kappa, lambda

62057.recognize_zh: 高倍 H&E 下，在大量小淋巴球與粉紅色組織球之間，散在幾顆大型細胞，核呈空泡狀、輪廓不規則或分葉，有些具明顯核仁；小淋巴球背景中的散在大型異型細胞是 NLPHL 的 LP 細胞（popcorn cell）線索。
features: Scattered large cells with vesicular, irregular to lobated nuclei and distinct nucleoli
Large cells have moderate pale-to-amphophilic cytoplasm
Background of numerous small round lymphocytes with dense chromatin
Interspersed histiocytes with abundant eosinophilic cytoplasm
Occasional apoptotic body; no eosinophils or plasma-cell-rich mixed background
62057.describe_en: High-power H&E section shows a lymphoid infiltrate composed predominantly of small mature lymphocytes and histiocytes with eosinophilic cytoplasm. Interspersed are scattered large atypical cells with vesicular, irregular or lobated nuclei and distinct nucleoli. The mixed background lacks prominent eosinophils or plasma cells, and sheets of large cells are not seen. The findings are consistent with LP cells in a lymphocyte- and histiocyte-rich background, in keeping with nodular lymphocyte-predominant Hodgkin lymphoma with a variant pattern; immunohistochemistry and architecture are needed to exclude T-cell/histiocyte-rich large B-cell lymphoma.

ddx.vs: Cytology is similar; THRLBCL is defined by diffuse growth without small-B-cell nodules or FDC meshworks.
Mixed cellularity shows binucleate HRS cells with large eosinophilic nucleoli and a background rich in eosinophils and plasma cells, which is not seen here.
PTCL shows atypical medium-to-large T cells across the background rather than scattered large B cells among bland small lymphocytes.

61993.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片 CD30 免疫染色中，一群中到大型的細胞呈細胞膜及核旁點狀（Golgi）棕色陽性，散在分布於小淋巴球之間，右側可見一個圓形、淡染的肉芽腫結構；少量散在的 CD30 陽性活化淋巴球符合 EBV 感染的反應性變化。
features: Cluster of scattered medium to large cells with membranous and paranuclear dot-like CD30 staining
Positive cells are single and loosely grouped, not forming sheets
Positive cells have round to oval nuclei without bizarre multilobation
Background of CD30-negative small lymphocytes, histiocytes and marrow elements
Rounded, pale granuloma-like structure at the right edge of the field
Bone trabecula and fat spaces at upper left
61993.describe_en: CD30 immunostain on a bone marrow biopsy highlights a loose cluster of scattered medium to large cells with membranous and Golgi-pattern staining, set in a background of CD30-negative small lymphocytes and marrow elements. The positive cells are single or loosely grouped without sheets, and a rounded granuloma-like structure is present nearby. Scattered CD30-positive activated immunoblasts adjacent to granulomas are consistent with a reactive response to EBV infection; classic Hodgkin lymphoma should be excluded by the cells' morphology and CD15/PAX5/CD45 profile.

ddx.vs: Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells are large with prominent inclusion-like nucleoli, are CD45-negative, CD15-positive and weakly PAX5-positive, and usually sit in a fibrotic mixed background rather than as reactive CD45+ immunoblasts.
ALCL shows sheets or sinusoidal clusters of large hallmark cells with uniformly strong CD30 and frequent ALK or loss of T-cell antigens, not scattered positive cells.
Lymphoma forms sheets of large atypical B cells with numerous EBER-positive cells, unlike this sparse immunoblastic reaction.

61929.recognize_zh: CD20免疫染色下，腦組織中許多大小不一的微血管內都充滿棕色陽性的大型細胞，而血管外的腦實質只有藍色（陰性）的膠質細胞核，清楚呈現B細胞淋巴瘤「只長在血管腔內」的分布，支持血管內大B細胞淋巴瘤。
features: Numerous capillaries and small vessels filled with strongly CD20-positive large cells (brown membranous/cytoplasmic staining)
Positive cells are strictly intraluminal, conforming to vessel outlines, some vessels containing single cells and others packed clusters
Tumor nuclei are large, vesicular and appear pale within the brown-staining cells
Background brain parenchyma with CD20-negative glial nuclei (hematoxylin counterstain) and no extravascular CD20-positive infiltrate
61929.describe_en: CD20 immunohistochemistry on brain tissue highlights large neoplastic B cells filling the lumina of numerous capillaries and small vessels. The positive cells are confined to the intravascular compartment, with no CD20-positive infiltrate in the surrounding neuropil, where glial nuclei are negative. This exclusively intravascular distribution of large CD20-positive cells is consistent with intravascular large B-cell lymphoma.

ddx.dx: Primary CNS diffuse large B-cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: Primary CNS DLBCL is also CD20-positive but infiltrates the parenchyma in perivascular cuffs and sheets rather than remaining within vessel lumina.
Intravascular NK/T-cell lymphoma is CD20-negative, expressing CD3epsilon, CD56 and cytotoxic markers with EBER positivity.

ddx.dx: Circulating normal B cells in vessels
ddx.vs: Normal intravascular B cells are small, sparse and admixed with other leukocytes, not large cells packing and distending multiple vessels.

61865.recognize_zh: 兩顆中大型淋巴球，核圓到稍多角形、染色質中等凝集，中央有一個明顯的大核仁，細胞質少量、藍色且無顆粒；這種「單一明顯核仁的前淋巴球（prolymphocyte）」是 B-PLL 的線索。
features: Medium-to-large lymphoid cells, roughly twice the diameter of a red cell
Moderate N:C ratio with a thin rim of pale-to-moderately basophilic agranular cytoplasm
Round to slightly polygonal nuclei with moderately condensed, clumped chromatin
Single conspicuous central nucleolus in each nucleus
Background red cells with scattered echinocytes/crenated cells and occasional platelets
61865.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows two adjacent medium-to-large lymphoid cells on a background of red cells with scattered crenated forms. The cells have round to slightly angulated nuclei with moderately condensed chromatin and a single prominent central nucleolus, surrounded by a modest rim of agranular basophilic cytoplasm. No hairy projections, cleaved nuclei, or blast-like fine chromatin are seen in these cells. In the appropriate context (prolymphocytes exceeding 55% of circulating lymphoid cells), findings are consistent with B-cell prolymphocytic leukemia.

ddx.vs: Leukemic MCL can show nucleolated prolymphocyte-like cells, so cyclin D1/SOX11 expression or t(11;14) must be excluded before diagnosing B-PLL.
CLL/PL shows a mixture of small mature lymphocytes with coarse block-like chromatin and smudge cells, with prolymphocytes below 55%, and a CD5+/CD23+/dim sIg immunophenotype.
T-PLL cells are often smaller with cytoplasmic blebs and irregular nuclei and express T-cell antigens (CD3, CD7) with TCL1 rearrangement rather than bright B-cell markers.

ddx.dx: Hairy cell leukemia variant (splenic B-cell lymphoma with prominent nucleoli)
ddx.vs: HCL-v cells have a nucleolus but also villous cytoplasmic projections and a CD11c+/CD103+/CD25- phenotype.

61801.recognize_zh: 高倍骨髓切片中，許多細胞核呈腎形、馬蹄形或摺疊（單核球樣），混雜顆粒球系與紅血球前驅細胞，中央有一顆核圓而不分葉的小型巨核細胞，符合 CMML 的單核球增生合併發育不良。
features: Hypercellular marrow with many cells showing reniform, horseshoe or folded monocytoid nuclei
Admixed maturing granulocytes with band and segmented forms and occasional eosinophils
Small megakaryocyte with a round non-lobated nucleus (hypolobated form)
Scattered erythroid precursors with dense round nuclei
No sheets of blasts identified in this field
61801.describe_en: H&E-stained bone marrow core biopsy at high power shows a hypercellular marrow with a mixed population rich in cells with reniform, horseshoe-shaped and folded monocytoid nuclei, admixed with maturing granulocytes, occasional eosinophils and erythroid precursors. A small megakaryocyte with a round non-lobated nucleus indicates megakaryocytic dysplasia. Sheets of blasts are not identified, although monocytic cells are best confirmed and quantified by CD14, CD68R or CD163 staining. Findings are consistent with chronic myelomonocytic leukemia in this patient with germline GATA2 mutation.

ddx.vs: aCML is dominated by dysplastic granulocytes with fewer than 10% monocytes, whereas monocytoid cells are prominent here.
AMML shows sheets of blasts and promonocytes totaling at least 20%, not a mixed maturing population.
Mast cell aggregates appear as spindle cells with clear cytoplasm staining for CD117 and tryptase, which are not seen here.

61737.recognize_zh: 肺組織 H&E 中，一條血管的管壁被密集的淋巴細胞浸潤而增厚，周圍肺泡隔增寬並有非典型大細胞與肺泡內巨噬細胞；淋巴細胞侵入血管壁（血管中心性）是淋巴瘤樣肉芽腫的典型發現。
features: Vessel with wall densely infiltrated and expanded by lymphoid cells (angiocentric/angioinvasive pattern)
Infiltrate composed of small lymphocytes with scattered larger atypical cells
Adjacent lung parenchyma with thickened alveolar septa
Upper field shows sheets of larger cells with abundant cytoplasm, including alveolar macrophages and atypical cells
No granulomas or neutrophilic abscesses evident
61737.describe_en: Sections of lung show a vessel whose wall is densely infiltrated by lymphoid cells, including small lymphocytes and scattered larger atypical cells, producing an angiocentric pattern. The surrounding alveolar septa are thickened, and nearby airspaces contain macrophages and larger cells with abundant cytoplasm. Well-formed granulomas and neutrophilic microabscesses are not present. The transmural angiocentric lymphoid infiltrate in lung is consistent with lymphomatoid granulomatosis, which requires demonstration of EBER-positive CD20-positive large B cells.

ddx.vs: GPA vasculitis is accompanied by neutrophils, microabscesses, and granulomatous inflammation rather than atypical EBV-positive B cells.
MALT lymphoma forms lymphangitic infiltrates of small monocytoid B cells with lymphoepithelial lesions and is typically EBER-negative.
Reactive infiltrates lack large atypical cells, EBER-positive B cells, and necrosis.

61673.recognize_zh: 中等大小的淋巴樣細胞，核圓、染色質中度濃縮並可見淡色核仁，深藍色細胞質邊緣長出明顯的圓形泡狀突起（cytoplasmic blebs），這正是 T-PLL 細胞的特徵性外觀。
features: Medium-sized lymphoid cell with high N:C ratio
Round nucleus with moderately condensed chromatin
Visible pale central nucleolus
Scant, deeply basophilic, agranular cytoplasm
Prominent rounded cytoplasmic blebs at the upper right and left margins
Background normocytic red cells; this image appears identical to the field in record 61680
61673.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a medium-sized atypical lymphoid cell with a high N:C ratio and a round nucleus containing moderately condensed chromatin and a discernible nucleolus. The scant, deeply basophilic cytoplasm forms prominent rounded surface blebs. No granules or vacuoles are present. Findings are consistent with a leukemic prolymphocyte of T-prolymphocytic leukemia at relapse, as stated.

ddx.vs: B-prolymphocytes have a larger, more prominent nucleolus, paler and more abundant cytoplasm without blebs, and a B-cell immunophenotype.
Hairy cells have delicate circumferential hair-like projections and pale gray-blue cytoplasm with a nucleolus-free oval nucleus, rather than discrete basophilic blebs.
Sezary cells have cerebriform grooved nuclei with scant pale cytoplasm lacking blebs and are usually CD7 negative, whereas T-PLL is CD7 bright.
ATLL cells show polylobated flower-shaped nuclei and are CD25 bright with HTLV-1 infection, unlike the round nucleus here.

61609.recognize_zh: 周邊血中可見一個中型芽細胞，核佔大部分、染色質細緻，胞質少量呈深藍色、無明顯顆粒，提示血中出現芽細胞；系列歸屬與 CEBPA 突變需流式與分子檢測。
features: Single medium-sized blast with high N:C ratio
Round to slightly irregular nucleus with finely dispersed chromatin
Scant, deeply basophilic cytoplasm without visible granules or Auer rods
Background red cells with crenation (echinocytic artifact) and mild anisocytosis
Platelets not conspicuous in this field
61609.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a circulating blast of medium size with a high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio, finely dispersed chromatin, and a thin rim of deeply basophilic, agranular cytoplasm. No Auer rods are identified. Background red cells show crenation, likely artifactual, and platelets are not conspicuous. In the context of the bone marrow findings, this is consistent with circulating myeloblasts of acute myeloid leukemia; lineage and the CEBPA mutation require flow cytometry and molecular testing.

ddx.vs: Agranular myeloblasts and lymphoblasts overlap morphologically; MPO and flow cytometry (CD13/CD33/CD117 vs CD19/CD10/cyCD3) are needed.
Reactive lymphocytes have more condensed chromatin and more abundant cytoplasm with peripheral basophilia, without fine blastic chromatin.
LGLs have mature condensed chromatin and abundant pale cytoplasm with azurophilic granules.

61545.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片 CD20 免疫染色只標出零星小型反應性 B 細胞（膜染色），而帶有大囊泡狀核與明顯核仁的大型非典型細胞則為 CD20 陰性，這種模式支持古典型何杰金淋巴瘤（CHL）的 HRS 細胞。
features: Only rare scattered small cells show membranous CD20 staining (background reactive B cells)
Large atypical cells with vesicular nuclei and prominent nucleoli are CD20 negative
Polymorphous background of small lymphocytes, histiocytes and stromal cells, all negative
Loose, somewhat edematous/fibrotic stroma without normal hematopoietic elements in this field
61545.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain for CD20 on a bone marrow biopsy shows a polymorphous infiltrate in a loose fibrotic stroma. Only rare scattered small lymphocytes show membranous CD20 positivity, while the large atypical cells with vesicular nuclei and prominent nucleoli are negative. There is no sheet of CD20-positive large cells. In conjunction with CD30 and CD15 positivity and weak PAX5 in the large cells, findings support marrow involvement by classic Hodgkin lymphoma.

ddx.vs: In THRLBCL the scattered large neoplastic cells are strongly CD20+ with CD30/CD15 negativity, whereas here the large cells are CD20-negative.
LP cells are strongly CD20+ and set in B-cell-rich nodules, unlike the CD20-negative large cells here.

ddx.dx: Peripheral T-cell lymphoma with HRS-like cells
ddx.vs: PTCL shows an atypical CD3+ T-cell background with aberrant antigen loss, and HRS-like cells are often EBV+ B cells, requiring T-cell markers and clonality to separate.

61481.recognize_zh: 血片中大量中型淋巴樣細胞取代正常白血球（僅見一顆中性球作大小對照），核圓或略凹陷、染色質粗塊狀、細胞質中等量淡藍，形態一致，符合成熟 B 細胞淋巴瘤白血化；標題中的 Auer 樣棒狀內含物在此解析度下無法確認。
features: Numerous intermediate-sized lymphoid cells, slightly smaller than the single segmented neutrophil present
Round, oval or slightly indented nuclei with coarsely clumped chromatin; nucleoli inconspicuous
Moderate amount of pale blue cytoplasm, some cells with a slightly eccentric nucleus
Eosinophilic Auer rod-like cytoplasmic crystals described clinically are not definitively visible at this resolution
No blasts, smudge cells or red cell agglutination/rouleaux evident
61481.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows lymphocytosis composed of monotonous intermediate-sized lymphoid cells with round to slightly indented nuclei, coarsely clumped chromatin and a moderate amount of pale basophilic cytoplasm; a single segmented neutrophil provides a size reference. The eosinophilic, needle-like Auer rod-like inclusions reported in this case cannot be convincingly identified at this image resolution. There are no blasts or smudge cells. Together with the monoclonal B-cell population on flow cytometry, the findings are consistent with a low-grade B-cell lymphoma in leukemic phase, with crystalline immunoglobulin inclusions raising lymphoplasmacytic lymphoma in the differential.

ddx.vs: AML blasts have fine chromatin, nucleoli and MPO-positive azurophilic Auer rods, whereas these mature-appearing lymphocytes carry immunoglobulin crystals.
Plasma cells have eccentric nuclei, perinuclear hofs and deeply basophilic cytoplasm and lack surface CD19/CD20, unlike these lymphocytes.
SMZL cells may show polar villous projections; separation from LPL relies on MYD88 L265P and clinical features rather than morphology alone.
Hairy cells have abundant pale cytoplasm with circumferential hairy projections and are CD11c/CD25/CD103/annexin A1 positive.

61417.recognize_zh: MUM1（IRF4）染色低倍（40x）見大型腫瘤結節幾乎全部細胞核陽性、纖維帶陰性；高倍（400x）為瀰漫強烈核染，這種強而一致的 MUM1 表現是 IRF4 重組大B細胞淋巴瘤的關鍵免疫表型線索。
features: Low power (40x): large nodules with diffuse, uniform nuclear MUM1 staining separated by negative fibrous septa
High power (400x): strong nuclear MUM1 in nearly all medium to large tumor cells
Positive nuclei round to oval with variable intensity but near-complete extent
Scattered negative stromal and endothelial cells
61417.describe_en: MUM1 (IRF4) immunohistochemistry demonstrates strong, diffuse nuclear expression in nearly all neoplastic cells within large nodules separated by negative fibrous septa. This uniformly strong MUM1 expression, particularly when co-expressed with BCL6 (and often CD10) in a young patient with nodal or Waldeyer ring disease, raises strong suspicion for large B-cell lymphoma with IRF4 rearrangement, which should be confirmed by IRF4 break-apart FISH.

ddx.vs: Pediatric-type FL is MUM1-negative or weak and lacks IRF4 rearrangement.

ddx.dx: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, ABC type
ddx.vs: ABC-type DLBCL is MUM1-positive but usually BCL6/CD10-negative or variable and lacks IRF4 rearrangement.
Plasmablastic lymphoma is MUM1-positive but CD20/PAX5-negative, CD138-positive and often EBER-positive.

61353.recognize_zh: 十二指腸黏膜低倍下，可見緊貼絨毛下方、位於黏膜層的大型淋巴濾泡結節，濾泡內細胞單調、缺乏明顯的極性分區，在十二指腸活檢中出現這種濾泡應考慮十二指腸型濾泡性淋巴瘤，需 CD10/BCL2 染色確認。
features: Duodenal mucosa with preserved villi and surface epithelium
Large, expansile lymphoid follicle occupying the mucosa and superficial submucosa, with a second smaller follicle at the lower left
Follicles composed of relatively monotonous small cells without obvious zonation or tingible body macrophages at this magnification
Thin rim of darker small lymphocytes around the follicles; lymphoid cells extend into adjacent villous lamina propria
61353.describe_en: Duodenal biopsy shows small-bowel mucosa with preserved villous architecture and large, expansile lymphoid follicles in the mucosa and superficial submucosa. The follicles are composed of relatively monotonous small cells without apparent polarization, and lymphoid cells extend into the lamina propria of adjacent villi. Cytologic detail is limited at this magnification. The findings are suggestive of duodenal-type follicular lymphoma; immunostains for CD20, CD10, BCL6 and BCL2 (BCL2 positive in germinal centers) with a low Ki-67 index are needed to distinguish it from reactive lymphoid follicles.

ddx.dx: Reactive lymphoid follicles (lymphoid hyperplasia, Peyer patch)
ddx.vs: Reactive germinal centers show polarization, tingible body macrophages and a high Ki-67 index, and are BCL2 negative.
MALT lymphoma shows marginal zone/monocytoid cells expanding outside follicles with lymphoepithelial lesions and is CD10/BCL6 negative.
Nodules are composed of CD5+/cyclin D1+ monotonous cells rather than CD10+/BCL6+ follicle center cells.

ddx.dx: Systemic (nodal) follicular lymphoma with secondary GI involvement
ddx.vs: Morphology overlaps; staging showing nodal or systemic disease and lack of IgA/CCR9 mucosal homing features separate it from localized duodenal-type FL.

61289.recognize_zh: 四個大型母細胞，核圓形偏心、染色質細緻並可見明顯核仁，細胞質豐富、灰藍色且無顆粒，核周無明顯淡染區；大型、細胞質多的無顆粒母細胞是單核母細胞（monoblast）的典型外觀。
