Dense mature chromatin; no nucleoli or blastic features
Normocytic, normochromic RBCs and adequate platelets
3049.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear at medium power shows increased small lymphocytes relative to other leukocytes. The lymphocytes have scant cytoplasm and dense, hyperchromatic nuclei with irregular contours, including notches and clefts. There are no blasts or large reactive lymphocytes, and red cells and platelets are morphologically unremarkable. Findings are suggestive of the reactive small-lymphocyte lymphocytosis of Bordetella pertussis infection in the appropriate clinical setting.

ddx.vs: CLL cells have round nuclei with soccer-ball chromatin and smudge cells in an older adult, and flow cytometry shows a clonal CD5+/CD23+ B-cell population.
Clefted buttock cells in adults are clonal CD10+ B cells, whereas pertussis lymphocytosis is polyclonal and seen in young children.
Sezary cells have cerebriform nuclear convolutions and a clonal CD4+ CD7- CD26- T-cell phenotype with erythroderma, unlike the simple clefts of reactive pertussis lymphocytes.

2985.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中多顆骨髓系前驅細胞與嗜酸性球內含大小不一、粗大的紅橘色巨大顆粒（giant granules），右上方一顆細胞的巨大顆粒沿細胞邊緣排列；另可見一顆含空泡的巨噬細胞。
features: Granulocytic precursors containing coarse, abnormally large red-orange cytoplasmic granules
Granules variable in size, some forming a peripheral ring within the cytoplasm
Mixed marrow population with erythroid precursors and lymphocytes
Central vacuolated macrophage with abundant pale cytoplasm
No blast excess apparent in this field
2985.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cellular mixture of granulocytic and erythroid precursors. Several myeloid precursors contain coarse, abnormally large red-orange cytoplasmic granules of variable size, clearly larger than normal azurophilic or eosinophilic granules. A vacuolated macrophage is also present. Findings are consistent with the giant granules of Chediak-Higashi syndrome.

ddx.vs: Pseudo-CH granules occur in a clonal population with blasts or dysplasia, whereas CHS affects all granulated lineages in a child with oculocutaneous albinism.
Toxic granules are fine and uniform within mature neutrophils rather than few, huge, irregular granules in precursors.
Alder-Reilly granules are dense and uniformly distributed in all leukocytes including lymphocytes, not sparse giant granules.

2793.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中大量小型淋巴細胞呈細胞膜棕色陽性，染色像是 T 細胞標記（如 CD3），陽性細胞密集散佈於脂肪空泡之間，顯示骨髓內淋巴細胞以 T 細胞為主，符合 rituximab 後的 T 細胞增生。
features: Numerous small lymphocytes with crisp membranous brown immunoreactivity (T-cell marker pattern, likely CD3)
Positive cells are interstitially distributed at high density between adipocytes
Positive cells have small round nuclei with condensed chromatin and scant cytoplasm
Admixed negative larger cells with paler nuclei represent residual hematopoietic and stromal elements
No large atypical positive cells or sheets of blasts identified
2793.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy immunohistochemical stain (presumed T-cell marker, e.g., CD3) highlights a markedly increased population of small lymphocytes with membranous staining, distributed interstitially at high density among adipocytes and residual hematopoietic cells. The positive cells are cytologically bland, with small round nuclei and scant cytoplasm, and no large atypical forms are seen. In a patient treated with rituximab, this pattern of T-cell predominance accompanied by B-cell depletion is typical. Findings are consistent with rituximab-associated reactive marrow T-cell hyperplasia; TCR clonality studies can exclude a T-cell neoplasm if clinically indicated.

ddx.vs: T-LGL shows intrasinusoidal linear arrays of CD8+/TIA-1+/granzyme B+ cells with clonal TCR, whereas this post-rituximab infiltrate is a diffuse polyclonal interstitial T-cell increase.
PTCL shows medium to large atypical T cells, aberrant antigen loss (CD5/CD7) and clonality, which are not seen in these small bland T cells.

ddx.dx: Residual B-cell lymphoma masked by CD20 loss
ddx.vs: PAX5/CD79a staining would reveal a B-cell population in residual lymphoma, whereas here the lymphoid cells are T-marker positive.

2601.recognize_zh: 抹片中一群異常前骨髓球，細胞質塞滿粗大的紫紅色嗜苯胺顆粒甚至遮住細胞核，核呈腎形或雙葉摺疊，部分細胞邊緣有無顆粒的藍色細胞質突起，符合急性前骨髓細胞白血病（APL）。
features: Cluster of large abnormal promyelocytes
Cytoplasm packed with coarse, dense purple-red azurophilic granules partly obscuring the nucleus
Reniform, folded or bilobed nuclei with fine chromatin
Pale-blue agranular cytoplasmic blebs (pseudopod-like) at the cell margins
Auer rod bundles (faggot cells) not clearly seen in this field
Few red cells and scattered platelets in background
2601.describe_en: Smear shows a cluster of large abnormal promyelocytes with abundant cytoplasm densely packed with coarse azurophilic granules that partly obscure the nuclear outline. Nuclei are reniform, folded or bilobed with fine chromatin. Several cells show agranular pale-blue cytoplasmic protrusions at the periphery. Distinct Auer rod bundles are not identified in this field. Findings are consistent with hypergranular acute promyelocytic leukemia; urgent coagulation studies and confirmation of PML::RARA by FISH or RT-PCR are recommended.

ddx.dx: Reactive promyelocytes (G-CSF effect or marrow recovery)
ddx.vs: Reactive promyelocytes have a round eccentric nucleus with a perinuclear Golgi clearing and orderly maturation to myelocytes, without bilobed nuclei or dense granules obscuring the nucleus.
These show myeloblasts with fewer granules, perinuclear hofs and single slender Auer rods with maturing neutrophils, and lack PML::RARA.
The variant has bilobed nuclei with sparse or invisible granules, whereas these cells are frankly hypergranular.
Cup-like blasts have a nuclear invagination with less cytoplasmic granulation and are CD34-/HLA-DR- like APL, so molecular testing separates them.

2345.recognize_zh: 低倍骨髓切片中，骨小樑之間的髓腔被淡粉紅色、無定形的膠狀物質取代，只見細小脂肪空泡、微血管與零星造血細胞，明顯細胞量過低，符合厭食症的骨髓膠狀轉化。
features: Marrow spaces largely replaced by pale eosinophilic, amorphous to finely fibrillar extracellular material
Markedly hypocellular marrow with only scattered small foci of hematopoietic cells
Numerous small clear vacuoles representing atrophic, shrunken fat cells
Thin, fragmented bone trabeculae
Scattered dilated capillaries containing red cells
2345.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy at low power shows thin bony trabeculae with intertrabecular spaces extensively replaced by pale eosinophilic, amorphous extracellular material. Hematopoietic elements are markedly reduced and present only as small scattered foci, and adipocytes are small and atrophic, appearing as tiny clear vacuoles. Capillaries are prominent within the matrix. Findings are consistent with gelatinous transformation (serous atrophy) of the bone marrow, compatible with anorexia nervosa; an Alcian blue stain can confirm the mucopolysaccharide nature of the material.

ddx.vs: Amyloid is glassier and often vascular or nodular and shows Congo red apple-green birefringence, whereas gelatinous material is Alcian blue positive and Congo red negative.
Edema appears as pale watery spaces without the fibrillar mucoid ground substance and retains normal fat cells.
Aplastic marrow is replaced by mature-sized adipocytes rather than atrophic fat cells in gelatinous matrix.
Necrosis shows eosinophilic ghost cells with nuclear dissolution and granular debris rather than an acellular mucoid matrix.

2281.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片充滿中型芽細胞，核圓至卵圓、部分有凹痕，染色質細緻、核仁不明顯，只有一圈淡藍色無顆粒細胞質，為典型淋巴芽細胞樣外觀；T 系需流式確認。
features: Medium-sized blasts, roughly 1.5–2 times RBC diameter
High N:C ratio with thin rim of agranular pale blue cytoplasm
Round to oval nuclei, some indented or notched
Finely granular chromatin with inconspicuous nucleoli
No Auer rods, granules or significant vacuolation
Normal maturing hematopoietic cells not evident
2281.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a hypercellular field replaced by sheets of medium-sized blasts. The blasts have high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios, round to oval nuclei with occasional indentations, finely granular chromatin, inconspicuous nucleoli, and scant agranular pale blue cytoplasm. No Auer rods or cytoplasmic granules are identified, and maturing myeloid and erythroid elements are not seen in this field. The morphology is lymphoblastic; T-lineage requires immunophenotypic confirmation (cytoplasmic CD3, TdT). Findings are consistent with T-lymphoblastic leukemia.

ddx.vs: Morphologically identical; distinguished by B-cell antigen expression (CD19, CD79a, PAX5) and absence of cytoplasmic CD3.
Myeloblasts often show more open chromatin, prominent nucleoli, occasional granules or Auer rods, and MPO positivity (≥3% blasts).
Burkitt cells have deeply basophilic cytoplasm with prominent lipid vacuoles and a mature sIg+ TdT-negative phenotype.

2089.recognize_zh: 薄層血液抹片中，多顆紅血球內可見帶一個紫紅色染色質點的小環狀體（ring form），中央另有兩顆紅血球內含多個分散染色質點的分裂體（schizont），紅血球內寄生蟲是認出瘧疾的關鍵。
features: Multiple intraerythrocytic ring forms with a single chromatin dot and a thin blue cytoplasmic ring
Two red cells in the center containing parasites with multiple scattered chromatin dots, consistent with developing schizonts
A more compact trophozoite with a larger chromatin mass and bluish cytoplasm at the right
Infected red cells are not conspicuously enlarged; no clear Schüffner stippling or banana-shaped gametocytes visible
Extracellular dot-like material and possible platelets overlying red cells in the background
2089.describe_en: Thin peripheral blood film shows numerous intraerythrocytic Plasmodium parasites at several stages. Ring forms with single chromatin dots, a more mature trophozoite, and two parasites with multiple chromatin masses consistent with schizonts are present. Infected red cells are not obviously enlarged, and Schüffner dots or crescent-shaped gametocytes are not clearly seen. Findings are consistent with malaria; species identification cannot be made with certainty from this field, and the presence of circulating schizonts argues against pure P. falciparum infection, so thick/thin film review and antigen or PCR testing are recommended.

ddx.vs: Babesia forms small pleomorphic rings without pigment or schizonts and may show extracellular forms and tetrad (Maltese cross) arrangements, whereas multi-nucleated schizonts here indicate Plasmodium.
Superimposed platelets lie in a different focal plane, show a halo and lack a cytoplasmic ring with a discrete chromatin dot.
These are dense inclusions without a surrounding blue cytoplasmic ring and do not form multi-nucleated schizonts.

P. falciparum typically shows many small rings, multiply infected cells, appliqué forms and crescent gametocytes with schizonts rarely in blood, while P. vivax/ovale show enlarged stippled cells and P. malariae band forms.

1961.recognize_zh: 高倍下見大量胞質淡染至透明、核為泡狀且輪廓不規則的中大型細胞，與小淋巴球、漿細胞及散在的嗜酸性細胞混雜，間有小血管穿行；透明細胞與多形背景並存，是 AITL 的高倍特徵。
features: Numerous medium to large atypical cells with pale to clear cytoplasm and distinct cell borders
Vesicular, oval to irregular nuclei with small nucleoli in the clear cells
Admixed small mature lymphocytes with dark round nuclei
Scattered plasma cells and eosinophilic cells, and a hyperchromatic large cell at center
Thin-walled vessels with plump endothelial cells coursing through the infiltrate
1961.describe_en: High-power section shows a polymorphous infiltrate dominated by medium to large atypical lymphoid cells with abundant pale to clear cytoplasm, distinct cell borders, and vesicular irregular nuclei with small nucleoli. Small lymphocytes, plasma cells, scattered eosinophilic cells, and occasional hyperchromatic large cells are admixed, and thin-walled vessels with plump endothelium traverse the field. Findings are consistent with angioimmunoblastic T-cell lymphoma; immunostains for CD3, PD-1, CXCL13, CD10 and CD21 are recommended.

ddx.vs: PTCL-NOS may contain clear cells but lacks a TFH immunophenotype and expanded FDC meshworks.
cHL has diagnostic Reed-Sternberg cells that are CD30/CD15-positive, while the clear cells here would be CD3/PD-1-positive T cells.

ddx.dx: Nodal marginal zone lymphoma (monocytoid B cells)
ddx.vs: Monocytoid B cells also have clear cytoplasm but are CD20-positive and arranged around residual follicles.
Clear cell carcinoma forms cohesive nests with keratin positivity and lacks admixed plasma cells and eosinophils with lymphoid markers.

1897.recognize_zh: 低倍淋巴結被單調的淋巴細胞瀰漫取代，只隱約看得到淡染的模糊結節（vague nodularity），缺乏清楚的生發中心與極性，並可見透明化的血管，符合套細胞淋巴瘤的結節／瀰漫生長型態。
features: Low-power lymph node with effaced architecture
Diffuse monotonous lymphoid infiltrate with vague, ill-defined paler nodules
No well-formed reactive germinal centers or polarized mantles
Eosinophilic hyalinized vessel/fibrous band near the capsule
Cytologic detail not assessable at this magnification
1897.describe_en: Low-power section of lymph node shows effacement of the normal architecture by a diffuse and vaguely nodular lymphoid proliferation. Ill-defined paler nodules are present without well-formed germinal centers, and a hyalinized vessel is seen near the periphery. Cytologic features cannot be evaluated at this magnification. Findings are suggestive of a low-grade B-cell lymphoma with a nodular/diffuse pattern, compatible with mantle cell lymphoma; cyclin D1, SOX11 and CD5 immunostains are needed for confirmation.

ddx.vs: FL shows crowded, well-defined back-to-back follicles of CD10/BCL6-positive centrocytes and centroblasts, whereas MCL nodules are vague and cyclin D1 positive.
CLL/SLL shows pale proliferation centers with prolymphocytes and paraimmunoblasts and is LEF1/CD23 positive and cyclin D1 negative (except in proliferation centers).
NMZL shows perifollicular/interfollicular monocytoid B cells with plasmacytic differentiation and is CD5 and cyclin D1 negative.

1769.recognize_zh: 組織切片中散布大型多形性細胞，細胞核不規則或呈腎形、核仁明顯，周圍混有細胞質充滿空泡的組織球與小淋巴球，符合間變性大細胞淋巴瘤（ALCL）伴隨組織球反應的表現。
features: Scattered large pleomorphic cells with irregular to reniform nuclei, vesicular chromatin, and prominent nucleoli
A large cell with dense amphophilic cytoplasm and a kidney-shaped nucleus near the center, compatible with a hallmark cell
Numerous histiocytes with multivacuolated, foamy cytoplasm
Admixed small lymphocytes with dark round nuclei
Loose, edematous stroma; moderate image resolution limits nuclear detail
1769.describe_en: Tissue section shows a polymorphous infiltrate of large pleomorphic cells with irregular to kidney-shaped nuclei and prominent nucleoli, admixed with numerous foamy, multivacuolated histiocytes and small lymphocytes in a loose stroma. Occasional cells resemble hallmark cells. The large atypical cells are less densely packed than in the common pattern, and the abundant histiocytes can obscure them. Findings are suggestive of anaplastic large cell lymphoma with a histiocyte-rich background; CD30 and ALK immunostains are needed to highlight the neoplastic cells.

ddx.vs: Histiocytic proliferations are CD68/CD163 positive and CD30/ALK negative, and lack atypical hallmark cells among the foamy histiocytes.
Hodgkin lymphoma shows Reed-Sternberg cells with owl-eye macronucleoli in an eosinophil- and lymphocyte-rich background and is PAX5 weak positive, ALK negative.
PTCL-NOS shows a spectrum of atypical T cells without uniform strong CD30 expression or hallmark cells, and is ALK negative.

1641.recognize_zh: 一片中型淋巴球，核圓形略不規則、染色質中度，細胞質量中等且淡染，彼此間有明顯空隙；右上角可見紅血球（紅髓），整體符合脾臟白髓外圍的邊緣區（marginal zone）細胞。
features: Sheet of small-to-medium lymphoid cells with round to slightly irregular nuclei
Moderately condensed chromatin with inconspicuous nucleoli
Moderate amount of pale cytoplasm giving spacing between nuclei
Occasional larger cells with vesicular nuclei
Red cells in the upper right corner indicating adjacent red pulp
1641.describe_en: High-power section shows a sheet of small-to-medium lymphoid cells with round to slightly irregular nuclei, moderately condensed chromatin and a moderate rim of pale cytoplasm, imparting evenly spaced nuclei. Occasional larger cells are admixed, and red cells of the adjacent red pulp are seen at the upper right. There is no significant atypia or mitotic activity. In the context of this series, findings are consistent with the normal splenic marginal zone.

ddx.vs: SMZL shows expanded marginal zones replacing the white pulp with red pulp infiltration and light-chain restriction, which cannot be judged in a single high-power field of normal-appearing cells.
Mantle zone cells are smaller with scant cytoplasm and more densely packed dark nuclei, whereas marginal zone cells have more abundant pale cytoplasm.
Hairy cells infiltrate the red pulp with oval to bean-shaped nuclei and wide clear cytoplasm and are CD103, CD25, annexin A1 and BRAF V600E positive.

1577.recognize_zh: 周邊血抹片中大量紅血球表面帶有多個尖刺狀突起，部分突起長短不一、分布不規則（棘狀紅血球 acanthocytes / spur cells），並混有較大、圓形的紅血球；在酒精性肝病背景下符合 spur cell anemia。
features: Numerous red cells with multiple surface projections (spiculated cells)
Many spicules irregular in length and spacing, consistent with acanthocytes (spur cells); some cells with more regular short crenations (echinocytes)
Spiculated cells often dense and lacking central pallor
Admixed round, normochromic, somewhat large red cells (possible macrocytes/target-like cells)
No nucleated cells, fragments or parasites in this field
1577.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a striking population of spiculated red cells, many with irregularly spaced projections of variable length consistent with acanthocytes (spur cells), admixed with cells bearing shorter, more regular crenations. The remaining red cells are round and relatively large with preserved central pallor. No schistocytes or red cell inclusions are identified in this field. In a patient with alcoholic liver disease, findings are consistent with spur cell (acanthocytic) hemolytic anemia; artifactual crenation should be excluded on a freshly prepared smear.

ddx.dx: Echinocytes (burr cells) from uremia or drying artifact
ddx.vs: Echinocytes have 10-30 short, evenly spaced, regular projections around the whole circumference, whereas spur cells have fewer irregular spicules of varying length.
These inherited disorders produce acanthocytes without liver disease and are distinguished clinically and by lipid profile or genetic testing.

ddx.dx: Post-splenectomy or pyruvate kinase deficiency spiculated cells
ddx.vs: These settings show acanthocyte-like cells accompanied by Howell-Jolly bodies or other clinical context, rather than cirrhosis with severe liver dysfunction.

1449.recognize_zh: 雙格骨髓抹片：右格可見大型巨核細胞只有單一圓形或腎形、不分葉的核（hypolobated megakaryocyte），這是 del(5q) MDS 的典型表現；左格則為各階段顆粒球及紅系前驅細胞，未見明顯芽細胞增加。
features: Two-panel composite of bone marrow aspirate fields
Right: megakaryocytes with abundant granular cytoplasm and a single round to reniform non-lobated nucleus
Left: granulocytic precursors at all stages of maturation with some erythroid precursors
Occasional larger cells with basophilic cytoplasm, likely early erythroid or myeloid precursors, without an obvious blast increase
Particle-rich background with fat vacuoles
1449.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate composite shows megakaryocytes with abundant granular cytoplasm and single, round to reniform, non-lobated nuclei. The remaining marrow elements include granulocytic precursors at all stages of maturation and erythroid precursors, with only occasional larger immature cells and no obvious increase in blasts in these fields. Findings are consistent with the hypolobated megakaryocytes of myelodysplastic neoplasm with isolated del(5q); karyotype and blast count are required for classification.

ddx.vs: ET megakaryocytes are large with hyperlobated, staghorn nuclei rather than monolobated nuclei.
This shows micromegakaryocytes or separated nuclei and additional lineage dysplasia without isolated del(5q).
CML shows small hypolobated (dwarf) megakaryocytes with marked granulocytic hyperplasia and basophilia and is BCR::ABL1-positive.

1513.recognize_zh: 中央漿細胞核偏一側，藍色細胞質內塞滿許多淡色、細長桿狀的結晶樣包涵體（箭頭），周圍另有數顆核偏位、細胞質深藍的漿細胞，是骨髓瘤漿細胞內免疫球蛋白結晶沉積的表現。
features: Plasma cell (arrow) with eccentric round nucleus and abundant blue cytoplasm filled with numerous pale, elongated rod-shaped crystalline inclusions
Additional plasma cells with eccentric nuclei, clumped chromatin and deeply basophilic cytoplasm
A large cell at left with open chromatin and abundant blue cytoplasm, possibly an immature plasma cell
Background granulocytes (bands/segmented forms) and small dark erythroid precursors or lymphocytes
Vacuole-like clear spaces are present, likely smear artifact
1513.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows increased plasma cells with eccentric nuclei and basophilic cytoplasm, admixed with maturing granulocytes and erythroid precursors. One plasma cell (arrow) contains numerous pale, elongated rod-shaped crystalline cytoplasmic inclusions, representing crystallized immunoglobulin. A larger cell with open chromatin and abundant blue cytoplasm may represent an immature plasma cell. Findings are consistent with a plasma cell neoplasm with crystalline inclusions; crystal-storing plasma cells may be associated with light-chain (often kappa) proximal tubulopathy (Fanconi syndrome) and should prompt renal correlation.

ddx.vs: In crystal-storing histiocytosis the crystals are within macrophages with small central nuclei and abundant pale cytoplasm, confirmed by CD68/CD163 rather than CD138 positivity.
Pseudo-Gaucher histiocytes have fibrillary 'wrinkled tissue paper' cytoplasm rather than discrete rod-shaped crystals in a plasma cell with a hof.
Auer rods are red-purple, needle-like and few per cell in blasts with fine chromatin, not multiple pale crystals in mature plasma cells.
Russell bodies are round globules rather than elongated crystalline rods, although both reflect immunoglobulin accumulation.

105.recognize_zh: 皮膚照片可見軀幹、背部大範圍色素沉著斑塊並有手掌角化脫屑；周邊血抹片中有小至中型、核輪廓不規則且染色質濃縮的淋巴球，流式細胞儀顯示 CD4+ T 細胞群失去 CD7 與 CD26，符合蕈狀肉芽腫（mycosis fungoides）侵犯血液。
features: Small to intermediate-sized atypical lymphocytes with high N:C ratio and scant pale-blue cytoplasm
Nuclei with irregular, indented to subtly folded contours and dense, coarsely clumped chromatin; nucleoli not evident
Occasional larger lymphoid cell with more abundant cytoplasm (reactive-appearing) admixed; red cells and platelets unremarkable
Flow cytometry: CD3+ T cells predominate with a dominant CD4+ (dim), CD8-negative population and very few CD8+ cells
The expanded CD4+ population is CD7-negative and CD26-negative, whereas a minor residual CD4+ subset retains CD7
Clinical photos: widespread hyperpigmented patches and plaques over chest, abdomen and back, with scaling and fissuring of the palm
105.describe_en: Clinical photographs show extensive hyperpigmented, partly scaly patches and plaques involving the anterior trunk and back, with palmar scaling and fissuring. The peripheral blood smear contains small to intermediate-sized lymphocytes with high N:C ratio, dense chromatin and irregular, indented nuclear contours; convincing cerebriform folding is subtle at this magnification. Flow cytometry of the lymphocyte gate shows a predominance of CD3+ T cells with a markedly increased CD4:CD8 ratio, and the dominant CD4+ population shows loss of CD7 and CD26, with a small residual CD7+ CD4+ subset. Findings are consistent with peripheral blood involvement by mycosis fungoides (circulating Sezary-type cells) in a patient with known cutaneous disease.

ddx.vs: Reactive T cells retain CD7 and CD26 with a normal or mildly increased CD4:CD8 ratio and lack a clonal TCR rearrangement, unlike the CD7-/CD26- CD4+ population here.
ATLL shows polylobated 'flower' cells, is typically CD25 bright and CD7-negative, and requires HTLV-1 serology for separation.
T-PLL cells have a visible nucleolus and cytoplasmic blebs, usually retain CD7, express TCL1, and present with very high lymphocyte counts.
CLL cells have round nuclei with block-like chromatin and are CD5+/CD23+ B cells (CD19+, dim light chain) rather than CD3+/CD4+ T cells.

captions: Anterior trunk with widespread hyperpigmented patches and plaques
Back with confluent hyperpigmented, scaly patches
Palm with hyperpigmentation, scaling and fissuring
PB: atypical lymphocyte with dense chromatin and irregular nuclear outline
PB: two lymphocytes with dense chromatin and slightly irregular contours
PB: small atypical lymphocytes with indented nuclei and scant cytoplasm
PB: small atypical lymphocyte next to a larger reactive-appearing lymphocyte
Flow CD45 vs side scatter: lymphocytes 64.45% of live cells
Flow CD3 vs side scatter: CD3+ T cells 60.90%
Flow CD4 vs CD8 (lymphocytes): dominant CD4+ population, few CD8+ cells
Flow CD4 vs side scatter (CD3 gate): CD4+ T cells 99.76% of gated
Flow CD7 vs CD4: dominant CD4+ population is CD7-negative
Flow CD26 vs CD4: dominant CD4+ population is CD26-negative

41.recognize_zh: 淋巴結結構被模糊的大結節取代，結節內以小淋巴球為主，散在核呈多葉狀、染色質淡、核仁小的 LP 細胞（popcorn cells）；CD21 類標記顯示結節內擴大的濾泡樹突細胞網，大細胞呈 B 細胞轉錄因子強陽性，符合典型型態的結節性淋巴球優勢型何杰金淋巴瘤（NLPHL）。
features: Scattered large LP (popcorn) cells with multilobated, vesicular nuclei, thin nuclear membranes and small to medium nucleoli, much smaller nucleoli than Reed-Sternberg cells
Background of monotonous small round lymphocytes with admixed epithelioid histiocytes; eosinophils and plasma cells are not conspicuous
Low power: effaced node replaced by vague, large, closely packed nodules
Expanded, crowded follicular dendritic cell meshworks filling the nodules (membranous-dendritic IHC pattern, e.g., CD21/CD23)

Large cells show strong membranous staining for a B-cell-type marker and strong nuclear staining for a second marker; a membranous marker outlines ring-like rosettes of small cells around some large cells
One stain is essentially negative in the large cells (pertinent negative, marker unlabeled)
41.describe_en: Lymph node sections show effacement of the normal architecture by a vaguely nodular proliferation of large, closely packed nodules. The nodules are composed predominantly of small round lymphocytes and epithelioid histiocytes, within which scattered large cells with multilobated vesicular nuclei and small nucleoli (LP or popcorn cells) are present; classic Reed-Sternberg cells are not evident. Immunohistochemistry (markers not labeled in the images) shows expanded follicular dendritic cell meshworks filling the nodules, membranous staining of the large cells for a B-cell-type marker, strong nuclear staining of the large cells for a transcription-factor-type marker, and a membranous marker highlighting numerous small lymphocytes with ring-like rosettes around large cells; a further stain is negative in the large cells. Findings are consistent with nodular lymphocyte-predominant Hodgkin lymphoma, typical (B-cell-rich nodular) pattern.

ddx.vs: LRCHL can form nodules but its Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells are CD30+/CD15+ with weak PAX5 and loss of CD20/OCT2/BOB1, and they sit in expanded mantle zones around regressed germinal centers.

THRLBCL shows scattered large B cells in a diffuse T-cell and histiocyte background without small B-cell nodules or CD21+ FDC meshworks, whereas this node retains B-cell-rich nodules with FDC networks.
PTGC forms large nodules of mantle-type small B cells with disrupted germinal centers but lacks LP cells with strong CD20/OCT2 positivity and T-cell rosettes.
FL nodules consist of centrocytes and centroblasts with BCL2-positive germinal center cells rather than scattered popcorn cells in a small-lymphocyte background.

captions: H&E, low power: lymph node effaced by vague, large, closely packed nodules
H&E, medium power: nodule composed of small round lymphocytes with rare larger cells
H&E, high power: LP cells with lobulated vesicular nuclei among small lymphocytes and histiocytes
H&E, high power: multilobated popcorn cell with small nucleoli and adjacent epithelioid histiocytes
IHC, membranous marker staining many small lymphocytes with ring-like rosettes around large cells
IHC, oil immersion: strong membranous staining of large cells, with a negative large cell centrally
IHC, nuclear marker (unlabeled) staining scattered small cells and large cells
IHC, high power: strong nuclear staining of lobulated LP cells with weaker small-cell staining
IHC, FDC marker pattern: expanded dendritic meshworks filling the nodules
IHC, low power: nuclear marker staining small cells in a nodular distribution
IHC, high power: stain essentially negative in large and small cells (pertinent negative)

2025.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片的細胞化學染色中，散在與成群的大型細胞質呈強烈深紅紫色陽性，大小遠大於背景的造血細胞與黃色紅血球；配合標題，這是高雪細胞（Gaucher cells）的強陽性染色（外觀最符合 PAS，但此圖無法確定染色種類）。
features: Numerous large cells, singly and in clusters, with intensely red-magenta positive cytoplasm
Cells several times larger than surrounding hematopoietic elements
Intense staining obscures nuclear and cytoplasmic striation detail
Background of unstained or weakly stained smaller marrow cells and yellowish erythrocytes
Low image resolution limits identification of the exact cytochemical stain
2025.describe_en: Cytochemical stain of a bone marrow aspirate shows numerous large histiocytes, singly and in clusters, with intensely red-magenta cytoplasmic positivity, contrasting with weakly stained or unstained smaller hematopoietic cells and erythrocytes. The intense staining obscures the fibrillary cytoplasmic texture and nuclear detail. The staining pattern is most compatible with PAS (or tartrate-resistant acid phosphatase), both of which are strongly positive in Gaucher cells, but the specific stain cannot be confirmed from the image alone. Findings are consistent with marrow infiltration by Gaucher cells.

ddx.vs: Staining characteristics are similar; separated by normal glucocerebrosidase activity and demonstration of the underlying disorder.
Foam cells are only weakly PAS positive with finely vacuolated cytoplasm and are sphingomyelinase deficient.
Striated histiocytes are PAS positive but contain acid-fast bacilli on AFB stain.
Megakaryocytes are also PAS positive but have large lobulated nuclei and granular cytoplasm and are CD61 positive.

4009.recognize_zh: 高倍骨髓切片中，脂肪細胞之間塞滿一致性的中小型母細胞，核圓至略有凹陷、染色質細緻、核仁不明顯、胞質稀少，幾乎看不到成熟髓系、紅系或巨核細胞；符合復發的前驅 B 淋巴母細胞白血病骨髓浸潤。
features: Sheets of monotonous small to medium-sized blasts packed between adipocytes
Round to slightly indented or convoluted nuclei with fine, evenly dispersed chromatin
Inconspicuous nucleoli and scant cytoplasm (high N:C ratio)
Near-complete replacement of normal hematopoiesis; no megakaryocytes or maturing myeloid/erythroid islands in field
Delicate stromal capillaries with a few red cells
4009.describe_en: High-power bone marrow core biopsy shows the intertrabecular spaces between adipocytes replaced by sheets of monotonous small to intermediate-sized blasts. The cells have round to slightly indented nuclei with finely dispersed chromatin, inconspicuous nucleoli and scant cytoplasm. Maturing granulocytic and erythroid elements and megakaryocytes are essentially absent in this field. In a patient with prior B-lymphoblastic leukemia, findings are consistent with relapsed B-lymphoblastic leukemia; TdT, CD34, CD19/PAX5 and CD10 immunostains or flow cytometry, and MRD assessment, are needed for confirmation.

ddx.vs: Myeloblasts often show more cytoplasm, distinct nucleoli and possible Auer rods, and are MPO-positive and PAX5/TdT-negative.
Burkitt cells have deeply basophilic vacuolated cytoplasm, starry-sky macrophages, a near-100% Ki-67 index, and are TdT-negative with surface light chain and MYC rearrangement.
Blastoid MCL is cyclin D1/SOX11-positive and TdT-negative with CCND1 rearrangement.
Hematogones are scattered and admixed with normal hematopoiesis with a maturational B-cell continuum on flow, rather than sheets replacing the marrow.

3881.recognize_zh: 周邊血中有數顆中型淋巴樣細胞，胞質強嗜鹼性、邊緣可見胞質突起（cytoplasmic blebs），核輪廓不規則、染色質中度凝集；這種帶有胞質泡狀突起的深藍胞質前淋巴球是 T 細胞前淋巴球性白血病（T-PLL）的典型線索。
features: Medium-sized lymphoid cells, slightly larger than small lymphocytes
Moderate, intensely basophilic cytoplasm with irregular borders and cytoplasmic blebs/protrusions
Irregular to slightly indented nuclei with moderately condensed chromatin; nucleoli small and not prominent in this field
Adjacent smudged/disrupted cell
Background red cells show crenation (echinocytes), likely artifactual
3881.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows several medium-sized atypical lymphoid cells with moderate amounts of intensely basophilic cytoplasm bearing irregular borders and cytoplasmic blebs. Nuclei are irregular to indented with moderately condensed chromatin, and nucleoli are small and not conspicuous in this field. A smudged cell is present, and background erythrocytes show crenation, likely artifactual. Findings are consistent with T-prolymphocytic leukemia; flow cytometry (CD3+, CD7 bright, CD4+ and/or CD8+, CD1a-/TdT-) and demonstration of TCL1A or MTCP1 rearrangement are required for diagnosis.

ddx.dx: B-cell prolymphocytic leukemia / CLL with increased prolymphocytes
ddx.vs: B-prolymphocytes typically have a single prominent central nucleolus and less basophilic cytoplasm without blebs, and express CD19/CD20 rather than CD3/CD7.
Sézary cells have cerebriform, deeply grooved nuclei with scant cytoplasm, are CD7- and CD26-, and patients have erythroderma.
ATLL cells show multilobated flower-shaped nuclei, are CD25+ and HTLV-1-associated.
Reactive lymphocytes are polymorphous with abundant cytoplasm scalloping around red cells and lack a clonal T-cell population.

3753.recognize_zh: 高倍下 G-CSF 刺激後的收集物：顆粒球前驅細胞（早期骨髓球、骨髓球、後骨髓球）胞質充滿粗大紫紅色顆粒，另有胞質灰藍、核摺疊且有空泡的單核球樣細胞，屬生長因子造成的反應性左移。
features: Large early myelocyte/promyelocyte with round nucleus, fine chromatin, and abundant coarse azurophilic granules concentrated toward one side
Myelocytes and metamyelocytes with indented to kidney-shaped nuclei and prominent purple-red granulation
Several cells with gray-blue cytoplasm, folded or lobulated nuclei, and discrete vacuoles consistent with monocytes
Cytoplasmic blebs and vacuolation in some cells
No Auer rods or abnormal blast population seen
3753.describe_en: High-power view of a post-G-CSF apheresis collection shows granulocytic precursors, including a large early myelocyte with abundant coarse azurophilic granules and several myelocytes and metamyelocytes with heavy purple-red granulation. Admixed monocytoid cells show gray-blue vacuolated cytoplasm and folded nuclei. Maturation is orderly, and no Auer rods or blast excess are identified. Findings are consistent with growth factor (G-CSF) effect with toxic granulation and left-shifted myelopoiesis.

ddx.vs: APL promyelocytes are monotonous with bilobed nuclei, heavy granulation, and Auer rod bundles, without a spread of maturing myelocytes and metamyelocytes.
CMML shows persistent monocytosis with dysplasia outside of growth factor exposure and often has clonal mutations such as TET2 or SRSF2.
AML with maturation has at least 20% myeloblasts, often with Auer rods and dysplasia, which are not present here.
